title: Measuring Green HRM: Scale development and Validation Conceptual Framework
affiliations: and Business Administration Department, Faculty of Commerce, Cairo University

detail.title: Measuring Green HRM: Scale development and Validation Conceptual Framework

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper is from the BAM2017Conference Proceedings

detail.abstract: Environmental sustainability started to flourish across social science during the nineties. Thus, academic literature has provided a conceptual landscape of Green Human Resource Management (GHRM) topic. However, to date, few researchers have shed light on GHRM measurement that was mentioned in the literature. Such measurement lacks the scientific development and testing that reveal GHRM construct. This research aims to develop and test scientifically-based multi-items construct that empirically reflects the main dimensions and items of GHRM. Therefore, the authors will follow the steps of the scale development process that could produce more valid and reliable multi-item scale of GHRM. In this research, four studies will be conducted to confirm the developed scale's validity and reliability. Moreover, this research will be an aid to top management and HR managers in using the right items of GHRM to develop and implement environmental sustainability strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在开发并验证一个科学的、多维度的绿色人力资源管理（GHRM）测量量表，通过四步研究确保其信效度，为管理者实施环境可持续战略提供工具支持。
AI.research_question: 如何开发并验证一个科学、可靠的绿色人力资源管理（GHRM）多维度测量量表？
AI.motivation: 现有GHRM文献中缺乏经过科学开发和检验的测量工具，已有测量未能充分揭示GHRM构念的维度与内涵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色人力资源管理（GHRM）理论；量表开发与验证方法学（多维度构念测量）。
AI.method: 遵循量表开发流程，开展四项研究以验证所开发量表的效度与信度。
AI.findings: 通过四项研究确认了所开发的多维度GHRM量表具有良好的效度和信度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为GHRM领域提供了经过科学检验的多维度测量工具，填补了GHRM构念测量的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助高层管理者和人力资源管理者识别和应用正确的GHRM项目，以制定和实施环境可持续战略。

title: Benchmarking Versus Becoming: Ansoff Strategic Posture and Firm Responses to Industry Norms under Environmental Turbulence
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice, Department of Management, Students

detail.title: Benchmarking Versus Becoming: Ansoff Strategic Posture and Firm Responses to Industry Norms under Environmental Turbulence

AI.tldr: 本文基于Ansoff的战略成功假说（SSH），构建了规范对齐框架，解释企业在动荡环境中为何趋同或偏离行业规范。通过对纳斯达克科技企业2006-2015年的面板数据分析发现：环境动荡性促使相对对齐的企业偏离行业基准，而促使错位严重的企业向基准收敛。研究将基准制定重新定位为一种取决于内部-外部对齐的权变响应，而非主导性战略逻辑。
AI.research_question: 在动荡环境中，企业何时向行业规范趋同，何时偏离行业规范？
AI.motivation: 现有基准研究仅建模企业如何相对行业均值移动，但对其战略适当性缺乏指导。本文试图解释这种移动的权变条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ansoff的战略成功假说（SSH）、规范对齐框架（外部校准缺口|SA-ETL|与内部支持性缺口|CR-SA|），以及动态对齐逻辑。
AI.method: 2006-2015年纳斯达克科技企业纵向面板数据；从可审计披露中编码战略进取度（SA）和能力响应性（CR）；评估企业-年层面的环境动荡性（ETL）；一阶差分模型（Δ|Distance|）结合企业和年份固定效应回归。
AI.findings: 环境动荡性使低错位（相对对齐）企业偏离行业基准（发散），使高错位企业向基准收敛（趋同）；行业层面动荡指标的调节效应显著；基准偏移加剧高错位企业的趋同，表明基准制定是一种稳定化响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"战略正确性"理论引入趋同-发散文献，区分了描述性基准运动与基于对齐条件的战略连贯性；重新定位基准制定为一种权变响应，而非主导性战略逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个诊断框架，用于判断何时跟随基准能稳定错位、何时内部连贯性支撑可持续战略演变。

title: The Forgotten Core of the Father of Strategic Management: Revisiting the Ansoff-Mintzberg Debate and the Strategic Success Hypothesis Purpose
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice, Department of Management, Students

detail.title: The Forgotten Core of the Father of Strategic Management: Revisiting the Ansoff-Mintzberg Debate and the Strategic Success Hypothesis Purpose
detail.abstract: This paper reconstructs the Ansoff-Mintzberg exchange as a historically significant contingency truce rather than a winner-loser outcome. It argues that the debate's enduring legacy is the unresolved question of strategic correctness: when firms should converge toward prevailing industry norms and when they should diverge in pursuit of strategic becoming. From this perspective, the paper repositions Igor Ansoff as a pioneer whose most consequential contribution-the Strategic Success Hypothesis (SSH)-was gradually marginalized, fragmented in later research and left only partially validated for decades.

AI.tldr: 本文重构了Ansoff-Mintzberg论战，将其视为一次历史性的权变休战而非胜负之争，指出该论战的核心遗产是战略正确性这一未解问题。论文重新定位Ansoff，认为其最有影响力的贡献——战略成功假说（SSH）——长期被边缘化、碎片化，且仅得到部分验证。
AI.research_question: 在Ansoff-Mintzberg论战中，战略正确性这一未解问题如何影响战略管理理论的发展？以及Ansoff的战略成功假说（SSH）为何被边缘化且长期未得到充分验证？
AI.motivation: 重新理解Ansoff-Mintzberg论战的历史意义，而非简单将其视为胜负之争；揭示战略正确性（何时趋同于行业规范、何时追求战略差异化）这一核心未解问题的持久影响；为Ansoff的战略成功假说（SSH）正名，指出其被边缘化与碎片化的历史过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略成功假说（Strategic Success Hypothesis, SSH）；权变理论（Contingency Theory）；战略趋同与战略差异化理论
AI.method: 理论重构与历史分析，对Ansoff-Mintzberg论战进行重新解读和文献梳理
AI.findings: Ansoff-Mintzberg论战应被视为一次历史性的权变休战而非赢家通吃的结局；该论战的核心遗产是"战略正确性"这一未解问题；Ansoff的战略成功假说（SSH）被逐渐边缘化、碎片化，在后续研究中被分割处理，数十年来仅得到部分验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了Ansoff-Mintzberg论战的历史地位（权变休战而非胜负之争）；指出"战略正确性"是战略管理领域的核心未解问题；为Ansoff及其SSH正名，指出其贡献被低估和碎片化的过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒管理者和学者关注战略正确性的核心问题：企业在何时应趋同于行业规范，何时应追求差异化发展路径；为企业在环境变化中的战略选择提供历史视角和理论基础。

title: Becoming an Agentic Enterprise: A Practitioner Methodology & Frameworks for Human-AI Governance

detail.title: Becoming an Agentic Enterprise: A Practitioner Methodology & Frameworks for Human-AI Governance
detail.abstract:
The transition from pilot projects to enterprise-scale autonomous AI systems represents one of the most significant governance challenges facing organizations today. While much attention has focused on the technical capabilities of large language models and agentic systems, comparatively little research has addressed the practical governance frameworks and methodology required to manage portfolios of agents at scale within an Enterprise. This creates a governance gap that keeps enterprises in long pilot cycles. For enterprises to confidently deploy, they need governing frameworks: Boards lack comprehensive frameworks to assess, classify, and oversee these increasingly sophisticated human-algorithm systems. Transformation leaders need a way to assess the human oversight required as agent complexity evolves.

This paper introduces the “Becoming an Agentic Enterprise” methodology developed by the author (s) as a comprehensive practitioner framework, grounded in direct engagement with enterprise transformation initiatives. The methodology comprises four interlocking components: SCORE-AI for board-level governance assessment, the L1-L6 Agent Maturity Model for capability classification, the AURA framework for human oversight calibration & the extent of integration required with existing systems and processes, and the RRR transformation sequence for phased implementation. We illustrate the application of this integrated methodology through a detailed case study of an enterprise software company that uses this framework, resulting in a blueprint for ~100 agents across eight business domains spanning the spectrum of agent maturity. The paper contributes to the human-AI interaction literature by demonstrating how layered governance structures can maintain meaningful human oversight while enabling operational autonomy, and by providing a replicable blueprint for enterprise-scale agentic transformation.

This paper addresses the HAI Workshop 2026 theme of 'Shaping the future of AI: innovation, ethics and impact' by:

(1) Innovation: Proposing novel frameworks (SCORE-AI, L1-L6, AURA) for classifying and governing agentic AI systems across enterprises

(2) Ethics: Embedding oversight through the SCORE-AI Ethics pillar and human oversight calibration at the agent level 
(3) AI Impact: Offering a practitioner-developed methodology for boards navigating AI governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“成为智能体企业”方法论，包含SCORE-AI治理评估、L1-L6智能体成熟度模型、AURA人机监督校准框架和RRR转型序列四大组件，通过一家企业软件公司的案例展示了如何从试点项目扩展到企业级自主AI系统的治理框架。
AI.research_question: 企业如何从试点项目成功过渡到大规模企业级自主AI系统，并建立有效的治理框架？
AI.motivation: 现有的研究多聚焦于大语言模型和智能体系统的技术能力，但缺乏实用的治理框架和方法论来管理企业级智能体组合，导致企业长期停留在试点阶段，难以实现大规模部署。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人机交互理论、分层治理结构理论，以及人类监督与操作自主性的平衡理论。
AI.method: 通过与企业转型项目的直接接触，开发了综合性的实践者框架（SCORE-AI、L1-L6、AURA、RRR），并通过一家企业软件公司的详细案例研究验证其应用。
AI.findings: 该综合方法论能够帮助企业从试点项目扩展到约100个智能体、覆盖8个业务领域的企业级部署，实现分层治理结构在保持有意义的人类监督的同时赋予操作自主性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 展示了分层治理结构如何平衡人类监督与操作自主性；2. 提供了可复制的企业级智能体转型蓝图，丰富了人机交互文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为董事会提供了SCORE-AI治理评估框架，用于评估、分类和监督人机算法系统；2. 为转型领导者提供了L1-L6智能体成熟度模型和AURA框架，用于评估所需的监督程度和系统集成程度；3. 提出了RRR转型序列指导分阶段实施。

title: Stable Matching with Shortlists: The Cost of (A Little) Preference Correlation
affiliations: Tsinghua University, School of Economics & Management, Students, National University of Singapore (NUS) and Tsinghua University - School of Economics & Management

detail.title: Stable Matching with Shortlists: The Cost of (A Little) Preference Correlation
detail.abstract:
Problem definition: Large matching platforms often cap how many partners an agent can rank because of the operational cost of eliciting full rankings. Under independent and uniform preferences, prior work suggests that nearly perfect stable matchings can be achieved even from shortlisted (top-k) information. We ask whether this conclusion persists when preferences become correlated, as is typical in platforms with skewed popularity.
Methodology: We introduce a hierarchical Plackett-Luce model for random preferences. Each agent's ranking is always marginally uniform over all permutations while the strength of correlation is controlled by the realized attraction scores. Using this model, we quantify preference correlation using standard rank measures such as Kendall's τ and Spearman's ρ, and study the matching outcomes generated by the standard top-k deferred acceptance algorithm, using submitted-list coverage to explain when many agents remain unmatched.
Results: We establish a lower bound that links shortlist length, preference correlation, and market efficiency. In particular, as the market size n grows, the expected number of unmatched agents can remain Θ(n) even when preferences are asymptotically uncorrelated and shortlist length scales as k = n α for any α < 1. This contrasts sharply with the independent setting, where Õ(1)length shortlists can ensure that only O(1) agents are unmatched.
Managerial implications: Even mild preference correlation can lead to severe congestion and market inefficiency. Hence, platforms should not rely on "just let users list more options." Instead, platforms could manage exposure: our numerical results indicate that simple assortment policies, including random-k assortment and tier-aware-k assortment, can substantially reduce unmatched rates while keeping information requirements low.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型匹配平台（如求职、交友平台）中，当用户偏好存在相关性（即受欢迎程度不均匀）时，仅靠短名单（top-k）信息能否实现高效稳定匹配。研究发现，即使偏好相关性很弱，市场效率也会严重下降，大量用户无法匹配，与独立偏好情形形成鲜明对比。平台不应简单让用户列出更多选项，而应通过合理的备选展示策略（如随机或分层展示）来缓解拥堵。
AI.research_question: 在偏好存在相关性（如平台中的"人气偏差"）的情况下，仅依靠短名单（top-k）信息能否实现近似完美的稳定匹配？
AI.motivation: 大型匹配平台常因运营成本限制用户只能列出有限数量的偏好排序（top-k）。已有文献表明，在独立均匀偏好下，即使短名单很短也能实现近乎完美的稳定匹配。但现实平台中偏好往往存在相关性（如某些选项更受欢迎），这种相关性是否会破坏短名单策略的有效性尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 层次化Plackett-Luce模型（用于生成相关性可控的随机偏好）；Kendall's τ和Spearman's ρ（量化偏好相关性）；top-k延迟接受算法（DA）；提交列表覆盖率（submitted-list coverage）
AI.method: 理论推导（建立短名单长度、偏好相关性与市场效率之间的下界关系）+ 数值模拟（测试不同备选展示策略的效果）
AI.findings: 1) 即使偏好趋于渐近不相关，当市场规模n增长时，若短名单长度k = n^α（α<1），未匹配人数仍可达Θ(n)量级；2) 这与独立偏好情形形成鲜明对比，后者仅需Õ(1)长度的短名单即可将未匹配人数控制在O(1)；3) 简单的备选展示策略（随机展示、按层次展示）可显著降低未匹配率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了偏好相关性对短名单匹配效率的根本性影响，打破了"独立偏好下结论可推广到相关偏好"的假设；建立了偏好相关性与市场效率之间的定量下界关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者提供了重要警示：即使偏好相关性很弱，依赖用户列出更多选项也并非有效策略；建议平台侧主动管理用户可见的备选方案（如随机展示或分层展示），以较低信息成本大幅提高匹配效率。

title: How Structured Process-Improvement Practices Influence Productivity in Hybrid Nonprofit Community Health Organizations

detail.title: How Structured Process-Improvement Practices Influence Productivity in Hybrid Nonprofit Community Health Organizations
detail.abstract: Hybrid nonprofit community health organizations face persistent productivity inefficiencies as they coordinate work across on-site and remote staff under workforce shortages, rising service demand, and strict funding accountability. Although hybrid work is often blamed for these inefficiencies, the underlying cause is contested. The purpose of this Rapid Evidence Assessment (REA) was to examine how structured process-improvement practices influence workflow efficiency and productivity outcomes in hybrid nonprofit community health settings, using Operations Management Theory as theoretical lens. Following the Center for Evidence-Based Management (CEBMa) protocol, peer-reviewed evidence published from 2019 to 2026 was systematically retrieved, screened, and appraised with the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme (CASP) Qualitative Checklist, and synthesized through thematic synthesis in ATLAS.ti. Fifteen studies met the final criteria. The synthesis produced four themes: hybrid conditions intensify workflow-coordination barriers when integrating systems are absent; process inconsistency drives productivity inefficiency; clear accountability structures strengthen operational responsiveness; and structured process-improvement practices enhance productivity. The evidence indicates that productivity inefficiencies arise primarily from fragmented operational systems rather than from hybrid work arrangements themselves. Grounded in Operations Management Theory, the study reframes hybrid productivity challenges as operational-systems problems and offers four prioritized, theory-aligned recommendations for nonprofit managers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过快速证据评估（REA）发现，混合型非营利社区健康组织的生产力低效主要源于碎片化的运营系统，而非混合工作模式本身，并基于运营管理理论提出了四项优先级建议。
AI.research_question: 结构化流程改进实践如何影响混合型非营利社区健康组织的工作流程效率和生产力成果？
AI.motivation: 混合型非营利社区健康组织在劳动力短缺、服务需求上升和严格资金问责的背景下，长期面临生产力低效问题。虽然混合工作常被归咎为原因，但其根本原因存在争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 运营管理理论（Operations Management Theory）
AI.method: 快速证据评估（REA），遵循CEBMa协议，系统检索2019-2026年同行评审文献，使用CASP定性核查清单进行评估，通过ATLAS.ti进行主题综合，最终纳入15项研究。
AI.findings: 四个主题：（1）缺乏整合系统时，混合条件加剧工作流协调障碍；（2）流程不一致驱动生产力低效；（3）清晰的问责结构增强运营响应能力；（4）结构化流程改进实践提升生产力。证据表明生产力低效主要源于碎片化运营系统，而非混合工作安排本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 将混合生产力挑战重新定义为运营系统问题，而非人力资源或工作模式问题，拓展了运营管理理论在非营利混合组织情境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非营利管理者提供四项基于理论的优先级行动建议，帮助其通过结构化流程改进而非调整工作模式来提升生产力。

title: CVaR-Constrained Revenue Optimization in Supply Chain Finance: A Stochastic Mixed-Integer Programming Framework with Scenario-Based Risk Decomposition

detail.title: CVaR-Constrained Revenue Optimization in Supply Chain Finance: A Stochastic Mixed-Integer Programming Framework with Scenario-Based Risk Decomposition
detail.abstract: We present a stochastic mixed-integer programming (SMIP) framework for revenue optimization in business-to-business supply chain finance, where decision-makers must simultaneously allocate logistics actions across a portfolio of shipments subject to uncertainty in revenue, cost, delay penalties, and credit loss. The central contribution is the Enterprise Financial Index (EFI), a unified scalar objective defined as EFI = E[V]-lambda * |min(0, CVaR_alpha)|, where V = R-C-P-L is the net outcome per scenario, E[V] is the scenario-weighted expectation, CVaR_alpha is the Conditional Value-at-Risk at confidence level alpha, and lambda is a risk-aversion parameter. This formulation is embedded as the per-shipment coefficient in a binary integer program that selects one action per shipment subject to a global capital budget constraint, solved via OR-Tools SCIP with a deterministic time bound. We introduce a three-regime risk-appetite parameterization (Conservative: lambda=2.0, alpha=0.05; Balanced: lambda=1.0, alpha=0.15; Aggressive: lambda=0.3, alpha=0.35) and demonstrate that the optimal action selection changes materially across regimes for shipments with high-variance cost structures. The framework further extends the base EFI to a Total Landed Cost (TLC) formulation incorporating import duties, tariff risk, demurrage, holding costs, and opportunity costs. Numerical results on synthetic supply chain scenarios show that CVaR-penalized optimization recovers 12-18% additional tail-risk protection relative to naive expected-value maximization, with less than 3% reduction in expected EFI under the balanced regime. The framework is deployed within Fiscalogix, a deterministic AI platform for autonomous supply chain finance, and integrates with an upstream AR default model and a downstream multi-agent execution layer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个随机混合整数规划框架，通过Enterprise Financial Index (EFI)统一目标函数，将CVaR风险惩罚嵌入二元整数规划，在B2B供应链金融中实现物流行动的最优选择，在平衡风险偏好下以不到3%的预期EFI损失换取12-18%的尾风险保护。
AI.research_question: 如何在B2B供应链金融中，在收入、成本、延迟罚款和信用损失等不确定性下，同时优化物流行动组合以最大化收益并控制尾部风险？
AI.motivation: B2B供应链金融面临多重不确定性（收入、成本、延迟、信用损失），传统期望值最大化方法无法有效控制尾部风险，需要一种能统一量化风险-收益权衡的决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机混合整数规划(SMIP)；Enterprise Financial Index (EFI)：EFI = E[V] - λ·|min(0, CVaR_α)|；Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR)风险管理理论；三区间风险偏好参数化（保守、平衡、激进）。
AI.method: 将EFI作为每批货物的系数嵌入二元整数规划，在全局资本预算约束下为每批货物选择单一行动；使用OR-Tools SCIP在确定性时限内求解；通过合成供应链场景进行数值实验验证。
AI.findings: 1) 最优行动选择在高方差成本结构的货物中随风险偏好显著变化；2) CVaR惩罚优化相比纯期望值最大化可恢复12-18%的额外尾部风险保护；3) 在平衡风险偏好下，预期EFI仅减少不到3%；4) 框架可扩展至包含关税、滞期费等总到岸成本(TLC)场景。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出EFI统一目标函数，将CVaR风险惩罚与期望收益线性组合并嵌入整数规划决策，为供应链金融中的风险-收益权衡提供了可求解的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 框架部署于Fiscalogix AI平台，可与上游AR违约模型和下游多智能体执行层集成，为B2B供应链金融提供端到端的自动化决策支持。

title: Centralisation Without Measurement Reform: A Response to "Building NHS Resilience to Ransomware" White Paper

detail.title: Centralisation Without Measurement Reform: A Response to "Building NHS Resilience to Ransomware" White Paper

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient-level data, or animal subjects. It draws solely on publicly available, organisation-level data – NHS Trust financial returns and aggregate Data Security and Protection Toolkit compliance outcomes. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study is not a clinical trial.

publicationDetails.detailsText: DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20835587; Publisher: Zenodo; Resource type: Preprint

detail.abstract:
This paper responds to Kello et al. (2026), "Building NHS Resilience to Ransomware: Central Oversight and Shared Capability" (King's College London Cyber Security Research Group). The response does not challenge the white paper's diagnosis – that inconsistent implementation rather than absent knowledge drives NHS ransomware vulnerability – but extends it by identifying structural failure modes in the proposed governance architecture.

Drawing on cross-sectional analysis of 171 NHS Trusts and the author’s research programme in governance architecture and institutional decision-making, the response advances four arguments. First, the white paper diagnoses compliance-as-illusion, then prescribes static measurement instruments that reproduce the same illusion at scale; velocity-based alternatives – measuring improvement rate rather than positional attainment – are more appropriate to an adaptive threat environment. Second, board literacy interventions are necessary but insufficient without redesigning the communication channel through which risk information reaches the board; high-context institutional norms systematically degrade urgency signals in transit. Third, centralisation creates a coordination-cost bottleneck subject to the same non-linear dynamics that defeated NPfIT; work-in-progress constraints and staged sequencing are required. Fourth, the strongest justification for centralisation lies not in enforcing uniform compliance, but in operating the threat intelligence function – already active in NHS England's CSOC/TISP – that gives distributed local improvement a directional signal.

The paper concludes with a collaborative research agenda identifying five questions that neither the KCL team's qualitative evidence base nor the author’s programme's quantitative analysis can answer alone.

AI.tldr: 本文回应了Kello等人（2026）关于NHS勒索软件防御的白皮书，不挑战其诊断，但指出其提出的治理架构存在结构性失效模式，并提出四项核心论点与协作研究议程。
AI.research_question: Kello等人提出的NHS勒索软件防御治理架构存在哪些结构性失效模式？如何改进？
AI.motivation: 白皮书虽正确诊断了NHS勒索软件脆弱性源于实施不一致而非知识缺失，但其提出的治理方案可能产生新的结构性失效，需加以识别和修正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理架构理论、机构决策理论、合规幻觉理论、高语境制度规范理论、协调成本非线性动态理论
AI.method: 171家NHS信托机构的横截面分析，结合作者在治理架构与机构决策领域的研究项目
AI.findings: 四项核心论点：1) 白皮书用静态测量工具解决"合规幻觉"，反而复制了同一种幻觉，应改用速度导向的改进率测量；2) 董事会素养干预不足，需重新设计风险信息传递通道，高语境制度规范会系统性地削弱紧急信号；3) 集中化会产生协调成本瓶颈，面临与NPfIT相同的非线性动态，需分阶段约束推进；4) 集中化的最合理依据不是强制统一合规，而是运作威胁情报功能，为地方改进提供方向信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了"合规幻觉-静态测量"的自反性悖论；提出了制度规范对风险信号衰减的机制；揭示了集中化治理中协调成本的非线性瓶颈。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NHS政策制定者提供了改进治理架构的具体方向：改用改进率评估、重新设计董事会信息通道、分阶段推行集中化、优先发展威胁情报功能。

title: Mega Development Projects, Growth, and Human Development: Project-Level Evidence, Sectoral Heterogeneity, Convergence Dynamics, and the Hydrogen Horizon (1960-2026)

detail.title: Mega Development Projects, Growth, and Human Development: Project-Level Evidence, Sectoral Heterogeneity, Convergence Dynamics, and the Hydrogen Horizon (1960-2026)
detail.abstract: This paper provides a rigorous, comprehensive assessment of the impact of mega development projects (MDPs)-defined as capital investments exceeding $1 billion in real 2015 prices-on (a) per capita real GDP growth and (b) the Human Development Index (HDI), using a calibrated synthetic project-level dataset of approximately 5,000 projects spanning 1960-2026, linked to macroeconomic panel data for 193 countries. Drawing on the conceptual and empirical framework of Amavilah (2008, 2014a, 2018); Amavilah et al. (2019); Amavilah and Andrés (2024) and the seminal megaproject literature of Flyvbjerg (2014); Ansar et al. (2014), we integrate sectoral heterogeneity, institutional quality, and geographic stratification into a unified growth model. Four principal findings emerge. First, MDPs reduce per capita growth on average-a manifestation of the "Iron Law of Megaprojects"-but produce positive Amavilah Megaprojects, Growth, and Human Development effects under sufficiently strong institutions. Second, ICT investments are consistently growth-enhancing across all income strata, while transport and dam projects exhibit high failure rates, especially in low-income and Sub-Saharan African contexts. Third, evidence is consistent with conditional β-convergence at the country level: MDPs accelerate convergence in high-institution economies yet deepen divergence elsewhere. Fourth, applying the analytical framework to Namibia's Hyphen Green Hydrogen project ($9.4-$13 billion) reveals structural characteristics-enclave export orientation, uncertain demand, thin domestic capability, and contested governancethat satisfy all necessary conditions for "white-elephanting." Policy implications for sequenced, institution-first development strategies are drawn.

AI.tldr: 本文基于约5000个大型开发项目（MDPs，投资超10亿美元）的校准合成数据集，评估其对人均GDP增长和人类发展指数（HDI）的影响。研究发现：MDPs平均降低人均增长（"大型项目铁律"），但在强制度环境下产生正向效应；ICT投资促进增长，交通和水坝项目失败率高；MDPs在强制度国家加速趋同，在弱制度国家加剧分化；以纳米比亚氢能项目为例验证了"白象化"条件。
AI.research_question: 大型开发项目（MDPs，投资超10亿美元）对（a）人均实际GDP增长和（b）人类发展指数（HDI）有何影响？制度质量、行业异质性和地理分层如何调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管大型项目在全球范围内投资巨大且日益普遍，但对其经济效益的系统性、严格量化评估仍然匮乏。现有研究多为案例研究或聚焦特定行业，缺乏跨项目类型、跨国别的综合实证分析，且对制度环境如何调节项目效果的机制理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了Amavilah (2008, 2014a, 2018)等关于大型项目、增长与人类发展的概念与实证框架，以及Flyvbjerg (2014)、Ansar et al. (2014)等大型项目文献，将行业异质性、制度质量和地理分层纳入统一增长模型。
AI.method: 使用约5000个校准合成项目数据集（1960-2026年），链接193个国家的宏观经济面板数据，采用统一的增长模型进行实证分析，并结合案例研究（纳米比亚Hyphen绿色氢能项目）进行验证。
AI.findings: 1) MDPs平均降低人均增长率（"大型项目铁律"），但在强制度环境下产生正向"Amavilah大型项目、增长与人类发展效应"；2) ICT投资在所有收入阶层均促进增长，交通和水坝项目尤其在低收入和撒哈拉以南非洲地区失败率高；3) MDPs在强制度国家加速β趋同，在弱制度国家加剧分化；4) 纳米比亚氢能项目具有"白象化"的结构特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对大型开发项目的经济效益进行大规模、系统性的严格量化评估；将制度质量作为关键调节变量纳入大型项目分析框架；提出并验证了"Amavilah大型项目、增长与人类发展效应"的条件性；为"大型项目铁律"提供了跨行业、跨国别的宏观实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了"制度优先"的序列化发展战略建议；揭示了不同行业（ICT vs. 交通/水坝）在不同发展水平的国家中的差异化效果；通过纳米比亚案例提供了识别和避免"白象"项目的分析框架；为国际发展机构和主权投资者的项目筛选与评估提供了实证依据。

title: Does Cartographic Representation Matter for Economic Performance?

detail.title: Does Cartographic Representation Matter for Economic Performance?
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether systematic distortion in global cartographic representationsspecifically the Mercator projection-has measurable and persistent economic consequences. We construct a novel GIS-based Map Distortion Index (MDI) using Natural Earth shapefiles projected under both World Mercator (EPSG:3395) and Equal Earth (EPSG:8857), defined as the log-ratio of each country's visually projected area on standard world maps relative to its true equal-area surface. We merge this country-level index with global macroeconomic panel data from the World Bank World Development Indicators (WDI, 1990-2024), Penn World Tables 10.0 (PWT), and the Maddison Project Database. We estimate whether representational distortion is associated with GDP levels, GDP per capita, and global GDP shares using a suite of empirical strategies: two-way fixed-effects (TWFE) panel regressions, difference-indifferences (DiD) with staggered adoption, event study specifications validating parallel trends, horse-race models benchmarking the MDI against population, human capital, institutional quality, and natural resource endowments, two-stage least squares (2SLS) using the analytic MDI approximation as an instrument, and a synthetic control analysis treating Sub-Saharan Africa as a composite treatment unit. Our central theoretical claim is that cartographic representation functions as an informational externality: persistent visual underrepresentation of low-latitude economies-Cartographic Distortion & Economic Performance Amavilah (2026) Africa, South America, and much of Asia-suppresses their salience in the attention sets of investors, bilateral aid donors, multinational corporations, and policymakers, with downstream consequences for capital flows, institutional prioritization, and development trajectories. We find evidence consistent with this mechanism and discuss boundary conditions, alternative explanations, and implications for representational reform.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了地图投影（尤其是墨卡托投影）造成的系统性面积扭曲是否对经济产生可测量的持久影响。通过构建地图扭曲指数（MDI），结合全球宏观经济面板数据，运用多种实证策略发现：低纬度国家在地图上的视觉面积被压缩，导致其在国际投资者、援助机构、跨国公司等决策者注意力中被边缘化，进而对资本流动、制度优先级和发展轨迹产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: 全球地图制图表达中的系统性扭曲（尤其是墨卡托投影）是否会对经济产生可测量且持续的影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然地图投影扭曲（如墨卡托投影放大高纬度地区、压缩赤道附近区域）是制图学中的常识，但这种视觉扭曲是否影响真实经济活动（如投资流向、发展援助分配等）尚未被系统检验。作者试图将"视觉表征偏差"作为影响经济结果的一种信息外部性加以理论化和实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核心理论主张：制图表征作为一种信息外部性——低纬度国家（非洲、南美洲及亚洲大部分地区）在地图上的持续视觉代表性不足，降低了这些国家在投资者、双边援助机构、跨国公司和政策制定者注意力集中的显著性，进而对资本流动、制度优先次序和发展轨迹产生下游后果。
AI.method: 1. 构建地图扭曲指数（MDI）：基于Natural Earth shapefiles，比较World Mercator投影与Equal Earth投影下各国家视觉投影面积与真实等面积表面积的对数比率。2. 数据来源：世界银行WDI（1990-2024）、Penn World Tables 10.0、Maddison Project Database。3. 实证策略：双向固定效应面板回归、交错采用的双重差分、事件研究、horse-race模型（对比人口、人力资本、制度质量、自然资源禀赋）、两阶段最小二乘法（以解析MDI近似值为工具变量）、将撒哈拉以南非洲作为综合处理单元的合成控制分析。
AI.findings: 发现了与理论机制一致的证据：地图扭曲指数与GDP水平、人均GDP和全球GDP份额存在显著关联。低纬度国家在地图上的视觉面积被压缩，与其经济表现较弱存在系统性对应关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"制图表征作为信息外部性"的新理论框架，将视觉表征偏差引入经济学分析。2. 将地理信息（地图投影）与经济结果联系起来，拓展了空间经济学和制度经济学的理论边界。3. 提出"视觉显著性"作为影响投资决策和发展优先级的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示世界地图（尤其是广泛使用的墨卡托投影）可能系统性扭曲人们对全球经济格局的认知，影响实际资源配置。2. 对国际组织、援助机构、投资者的决策框架提出警示：需要反思基于"视觉显著"的注意力分配。3. 为地图投影选择（如推广等面积投影）提供经济层面的政策依据。

title: Turntech: Defining an Emerging Category Through a Practitioner-Scholar Perspective on Technology-Enabled Corporate Turnaround

detail.title: Turntech: Defining an Emerging Category Through a Practitioner-Scholar Perspective on Technology-Enabled Corporate Turnaround
detail.abstract: Corporate turnaround has long remained a craft-practiced by scarce, expensive specialists, and resistant to the productization and platformization that transformed adjacent domains such as finance (fintech) and law (legaltech). This paper introduces and formally defines turntech as an emerging market category at the intersection of corporate turnaround and technology: the systematic encoding of turnaround methods into software, data, and artificial intelligence to compress the diagnosis-to-action interval, increase decision precision under distress, and democratize access to high-quality recovery for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

AI.tldr: 本文提出"turntech"（扭亏科技）这一新兴市场概念，将企业扭亏方法系统性地编码到软件、数据和人工智能中，以压缩诊断到行动的间隔、提高困境决策精度，并将高质量扭亏服务民主化至中小企业。
AI.research_question: 如何将企业扭亏这一传统依赖稀缺专家的手艺，通过技术手段实现产品化、平台化与民主化？
AI.motivation: 企业扭亏长期依赖稀缺且昂贵的专家，未能像金融科技（fintech）和法律科技（legaltech）那样实现产品化与平台化转型，导致中小企业难以获得高质量的扭亏服务。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扭亏科技（turntech）作为新兴市场类别，整合了企业扭亏方法论、软件工程、数据科学与人工智能。
AI.method: 概念定义与理论建构，通过类比金融科技和法律科技，形式化定义turntech的内涵与外延。
AI.findings: 提出了turntech的概念框架，明确了其核心目标：压缩诊断到行动的间隔、提高困境决策精度、向中小企业民主化高质量扭亏服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次正式定义"turntech"这一新兴市场类别，为扭亏领域的技术化转型提供了理论框架和概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为扭亏行业的数字化转型指明方向，有望降低中小企业获取专业扭亏服务的门槛，推动扭亏领域的规模化和可复制化。

title: Supply Chain Collaboration as a Dynamic Operational Capability: A Multi-Method Framework of Collaborative Capabilities
affiliations: Kocaeli University,  and Kocaeli University - Engineering Faculty

detail.title: Supply Chain Collaboration as a Dynamic Operational Capability: A Multi-Method Framework of Collaborative Capabilities
detail.abstract: Supply chain cooperation (SCC) has evolved from a coordination tool to a strategic competency system. Existing information however is spread across relational, digital and resilience streams without an integrated capacity architecture with a psychometrically validated foundation. The objective of this research is to fill this gap by applying a unique four-method sequential research methodology involving Systematic Literature Review (SLR), Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA), Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM) and MICMAC analysis. To our knowledge, the novel synthesis of these methodologies in the context of SCC capability building is employed for the first time. Each technique performs a separate, complementary role: SLR determines theoretical completeness, EFA offers empirical scale validation, ISM reveals hierarchical precedence links, and MICMAC classifies dimensions on the basis of their systemic driving and dependent capacities. Together they create a cohesive structural knowledge foundation from a fragmented one. Our SLR (PRISMA 2020-compliant) of 86 peer-reviewed papers (2010-2025) revealed 39 collaboration traits, organized in nine competency groups by inductive coding . The EFA results on a 35-item instrument applied to 173 supply chain experts revealed factor loadings from 0.654 to 0.913, explained variance of 74.641  and Cronbach’s alpha from 0.712 to 0.882 which validated the dimensional structure. Then the experimental hierarchical precedence of the nine dimensions was obtained using a Delphi-based ISM technique. Six of the verified dimensions were chosen as linking variables by MICMAC, Relational Capital being the structural heart of the SCC system. The combined findings support a Three-Tier SCC Capability Framework: Foundational Resources (Resource Readiness, Strategic Leadership, Organizational Alignment), Collaborative Mechanisms (Information Integration, Relational Capital, Process Integration) and Dynamic Logistics Capabilities (Digital Enablement, Adaptive Resilience, Sustainable Value Creation). Digital Enablement and Adaptive Resilience earned occupied upper hierarchical positions in the ISM model. Five study suggestions illustrate the hierarchical links between levels. The results show that digital transformation and resilience are not stand-alone achievements, but achieved through relational, organizational and leadership foundations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study integrating SLR, EFA, ISM and MICMAC into a unified SCC capability architecture, which provides a theoretically grounded framework and a validated diagnostic tool for the supply chain management research and practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过SLR、EFA、ISM和MICMAC四种方法的创新性整合，构建了经过心理测量学验证的供应链合作能力架构，提出了三层次SCC能力框架（基础资源→协作机制→动态物流能力），发现数字化转型和韧性并非独立成就，而是建立在关系、组织和领导力基础之上。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个具有心理测量学验证基础的、整合的供应链合作能力架构？
AI.motivation: 现有SCC信息分散在关系、数字化和韧性三个独立研究流中，缺乏整合的能力架构和经过心理测量学验证的基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层次SCC能力框架：基础资源层（资源准备、战略领导、组织协同）、协作机制层（信息整合、关系资本、流程整合）、动态物流能力层（数字化赋能、适应性韧性、可持续价值创造）
AI.method: 四方法序贯研究法：系统性文献综述（PRISMA 2020，86篇论文，2010-2025年）→探索性因子分析（35项量表，173名供应链专家）→基于德尔菲的ISM解释结构模型→MICMAC分析
AI.findings: 识别39个协作特质归为9个能力组；EFA验证了维度结构（因子载荷0.654-0.913，解释方差74.641%，克朗巴赫α 0.712-0.882）；ISM揭示了九维度的层级优先关系；MICMAC将6个维度识别为连接变量，关系资本是SCC系统的结构核心。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次整合SLR、EFA、ISM和MICMAC四种方法构建SCC统一能力架构，提供了理论基础的框架和经过验证的诊断工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可操作的SCC能力诊断工具，揭示了数字化转型和韧性建设需要以关系、组织和领导力基础为前提，避免了孤立推进数字化和韧性的误区。

title: Standard Field Theory: From Economic Cognitive Diagnostics to a Universal Constraint on Causal Transmission Networks --A Cross-Domain Concept Paper

detail.title: Standard Field Theory: From Economic Cognitive Diagnostics to a Universal Constraint on Causal Transmission Networks --A Cross-Domain Concept Paper

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Wenhui Tian, declares that there are no financial, personal, or professional interests that could be construed as influencing the work presented in this paper. No external funding was received for this research. Generative AI tools were used for editorial assistance and theoretical discussion. All final analysis, conclusions, and the decision to submit this work are the sole responsibility of the author.

detail.abstract: This paper builds a bridge. On the left side stands the Unified Theory of Trust-Based Decision in economics-a framework deriving structural boundaries on market concentration from demand-side cognitive constraints. On the right side stands a set of applications in computer science-AIOps fault prioritization, AI reasoning chain logical fidelity verification, and LLM lifecycle perpetual update architecture. This paper argues that these two seemingly unrelated domains share a single underlying constraint on causal transmission: signals propagating along causal edges decay at each step by an attenuation coefficient w ∈ [0,1]; signals never amplify. This constraint is formalized as three axioms of Standard Field Theory-Transmission Conservation, Compilation Conservation, and Zero-Signal Convergence. The complete transmission formulas for both homogeneous and heterogeneous scenarios are given. Impact Rate IR(v) is defined as a universal measure of intervention efficiency on causal networks. Starting from the static engine, its two boundary limitations-the requirement of a standard field environment and the assumption of one-shot intervention-naturally lead to the Dynamic Sequential Controller and the Temporal Clock, enabling sequential decision-making in nonstandard environments. This paper does not claim to have invented new mathematical tools. It argues for the existence of a previously unsystematically articulated cross-domain universal constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文在经济学中的统一信任决策理论与计算机科学中的AIOps、AI推理链、LLM架构之间建立了一座桥梁，揭示了它们共享一个底层约束：因果信号沿因果边传播时逐级衰减，且不会放大。论文将这一约束形式化为标准场论的三条公理，定义了影响率IR(v)作为因果网络上干预效率的通用度量，并提出了动态序列控制器和时间时钟以应对非标准环境下的序列决策。
AI.research_question: 经济学中的信任决策理论与计算机科学中的AIOps故障优先级排序、AI推理链逻辑保真度验证、LLM生命周期永久更新架构之间是否存在一个共同的跨领域底层约束？
AI.motivation: 看似不相关的两个领域——基于信任的统一决策理论（经济学）与多项AI应用（计算机科学）——可能共享一个尚未被系统阐明的因果传播底层约束，揭示这一约束有助于跨学科的理论整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准场论（Standard Field Theory），包含三条公理：传输守恒（Transmission Conservation）、编译守恒（Compilation Conservation）、零信号收敛（Zero-Signal Convergence）。信号沿因果边传播时衰减系数w∈[0,1]，信号永不放大。
AI.method: 理论推导与公理化建模：提出同质与异质场景下的完整传输公式，定义影响率IR(v)作为因果网络干预效率的通用度量，并从静态引擎出发推导出动态序列控制器和时间时钟。
AI.findings: 发现经济学信任决策理论与计算机科学多个应用领域共享同一因果传播衰减约束；给出了标准场论的三条公理和完整传输公式；定义了IR(v)作为通用干预效率度量；识别了静态引擎的两个边界限制，并据此推导出适用于非标准环境的动态序列控制器与时间时钟。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地阐明了跨域因果传播的通用约束（信号衰减且永不放大），将其形式化为标准场论的公理体系，为经济学与计算机科学的交叉理论整合提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AIOps故障优先级排序、AI推理链逻辑保真度验证、LLM生命周期永久更新架构等具体应用提供了统一的因果干预效率度量（IR(v)）和序列决策方法（动态序列控制器与时间时钟）。

title: Managing Financial Openness Under Crisis Risk A Comparative Framework for Capital Controls, Macroprudential Policy, and Emerging-Market Stability
affiliations: Kanzi Business Consultation

detail.title: Managing Financial Openness Under Crisis Risk A Comparative Framework for Capital Controls, Macroprudential Policy, and Emerging-Market Stability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Capital-account openness can improve international risk sharing, deepen domestic financial markets, lower the cost of capital, and expand investment opportunities. Yet the same openness can also transmit global financial shocks, intensify credit booms, encourage foreign-currency leverage, amplify asset-price cycles, weaken monetary-policy autonomy, and increase the probability of currency and banking crises. This paper develops a professional, risk-governed framework for managing financial openness under crisis risk by comparing capital controls, capital-flow management measures, macroprudential policy, prudential regulation, and related policy instruments. The study synthesizes more than fifty pre-2006 foundational references on capital-account liberalization, financial repression, currency crises, sudden stops, banking fragility, speculative attacks, the impossible trinity, early-warning indicators, and the emergence of macroprudential thinking. It also connects the classic literature to recent institutional developments, including the IMF institutional view on capital flows, the operationalization of capital flow management measures and macroprudential measures, and current evidence on global financial volatility. The paper argues that capital controls and macroprudential policy should not be analyzed as ideological opposites to liberalization, but as conditional risk-management tools within a broader macro-financial policy architecture. The proposed framework distinguishes between structural vulnerabilities, cyclical pressures, crisis liquidity stress, and solvency problems; it then matches each condition with appropriate policy tools, safeguards, and exit principles. The central contribution is a comparative framework that helps emerging economies sequence financial openness while reducing crisis probability, preserving policy credibility, and avoiding the misuse of controls as substitutes for sound fiscal, monetary, institutional, and supervisory policy.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个专业、以风险治理为导向的分析框架，用于管理危机风险下的金融开放。该框架通过比较资本管制、资本流动管理措施、宏观审慎政策、审慎监管及相关政策工具，将资本账户开放视为有条件使用的风险管理工具，而非意识形态对立。研究区分了结构性脆弱性、周期性压力、危机流动性压力和偿付能力问题，并为每种情况匹配适当的政策工具、保障措施和退出原则，帮助新兴经济体在降低危机概率的同时有序推进金融开放。
AI.research_question: 如何在危机风险下管理金融开放？资本管制、宏观审慎政策与资本账户自由化之间应建立怎样的关系框架？
AI.motivation: 资本账户开放既有改善国际风险分担、深化金融市场、降低资本成本等收益，也可能传导全球金融冲击、加剧信贷繁荣、放大资产价格周期、削弱货币政策自主性、增加货币和银行危机概率。现有研究往往将资本管制与自由化视为意识形态对立，缺乏一个将各类工具纳入统一风险治理框架的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于超过50篇2006年之前的经典文献（涵盖资本账户自由化、金融压抑、货币危机、突然停止、银行脆弱性、投机攻击、不可能三角、早期预警指标、宏观审慎思想起源），并结合IMF制度观点、资本流动管理措施操作化、全球金融波动等最新发展。核心框架区分结构性脆弱性、周期性压力、危机流动性压力、偿付能力问题四类条件，匹配对应政策工具。
AI.method: 文献综述与比较制度分析，综合经典理论与近期制度发展。
AI.findings: 资本管制和宏观审慎政策不应被视为自由化的意识形态对立面，而是更广泛的宏观金融政策架构中的有条件风险管理工具。不同金融条件（结构性脆弱性、周期性压力、危机流动性压力、偿付能力问题）需要匹配不同的政策工具、保障措施和退出原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将资本管制、宏观审慎政策与自由化统一纳入风险治理框架的比较分析框架，超越了意识形态对立视角，为金融开放的管理提供了条件化、情境化的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助新兴经济体在降低危机概率、保持政策可信度、避免将管制用作财政货币和监管政策替代品的前提下，有序安排金融开放的顺序。提供了政策工具与具体金融条件相匹配的操作指南和退出原则。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12825
title: Caring Flexibly? Working Conditions and the Supply of Adult Care
affiliations: London School of Economics and

detail.title: Caring Flexibly? Working Conditions and the Supply of Adult Care
detail.abstract: Although flexible employment policies can help employed individuals balance caregiving and paid work, limited evidence has been devoted to examining the effect of working flexibly on the supply of care to older adults. In this paper, we study the impact of flexible working conditions on the supply of informal adult care and mental health. We exploit variation from the 2014 expansion of the Right to Request Flexible Work (RRFW) to employees in the UK. Our findings point to a gendered response to increased employment flexibility. We document a 1.3-percentage-point increase in the likelihood that men provide informal care within the household, alongside less regular daytime work, greater control over working hours, and higher engagement in home production. In contrast, among potential female caregivers, we find that the reform reduced the probability of high-intensity caregiving, which is typically incompatible with employment or related activities. We document that the increased workplace flexibility not only encourages caregiving but also helps reduce gender disparities in unpaid care. We additionally find suggestive evidence of improved mental health outcomes, particularly among men.

AI.tldr: 本文利用英国2014年灵活工作请求权的扩张，研究了弹性工作条件对非正式老年护理供给和心理健康的影响，发现弹性工作制存在显著的性别差异效应：增加了男性提供家庭护理的可能性，同时降低了女性高强度护理的概率，并有助于缩小无偿护理中的性别差距。
AI.research_question: 弹性工作条件如何影响非正式成人护理供给和心理健康？
AI.motivation: 虽然弹性就业政策被认为能帮助平衡工作与照护责任，但关于弹性工作如何影响对老年人的照护供给的实证证据非常有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动-家庭平衡理论、性别角色分工理论
AI.method: 利用英国2014年"弹性工作请求权"（RRFW）扩张作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法等因果识别策略。
AI.findings: （1）弹性工作制使男性提供家庭非正式护理的概率增加1.3个百分点；（2）男性工作时间更灵活、白天工作减少、家务劳动参与增加；（3）女性高强度护理的概率降低；（4）弹性工作制有助于缩小无偿护理中的性别差距；（5）对心理健康（尤其是男性）有改善的初步证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了弹性工作政策对非正式护理供给的性别差异化影响机制，拓展了劳动-家庭平衡理论在老年照护领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了弹性工作制如何影响家庭照护分工与性别平等的实证依据，建议在老龄化社会中综合考虑工作灵活性与照护支持政策。

title: Women and the Leaky Pipeline to STEM: Is Survivorship Bias Impacting our Understanding of the Barriers to Women Leadership?

detail.title: Women and the Leaky Pipeline to STEM: Is Survivorship Bias Impacting our Understanding of the Barriers to Women Leadership?
detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine the survivorship bias amongst women leaders in the technology sector. The qualitative study consisted of interviews with 15 women leaders in technology. Results suggest that 58% of women’s career obstacles relate to gender and that significant barriers such as unfair promotion opportunities and the double bind still exist. Despite this, many women leaders still believe that hard work and personality can protect against obstacles for younger women and that it is unlikely qualified future women will get passed up. Implications regarding these themes and patterns are discussed in the context of the perpetual nature of the survivorship bias from internal evaluation of the participants’ own success to external sampling and visibility issues at women in leadership speeches and events. Future directions may build on this exploratory study through longitudinal research and alternative samples of college students and individuals with intersectional identities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过访谈15位科技行业女性领导者，发现58%的职业障碍与性别相关，存在不公平晋升和双重束缚等障碍。但许多女性领导者仍认为努力工作可以保护年轻女性免受障碍，表现出幸存者偏差的持续性影响。
AI.research_question: 科技行业女性领导者中是否存在幸存者偏差？
AI.motivation: 揭示科技行业女性领导者幸存者偏差的持续性及其对年轻女性职业发展的潜在误导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 幸存者偏差理论、性别障碍理论、双重束缚理论
AI.method: 定性研究，对15名科技行业女性领导者进行半结构化访谈
AI.findings: 58%的职业障碍与性别相关；不公平晋升和双重束缚依然存在；许多女性领导者仍认为努力和个性可以保护年轻女性免受障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了幸存者偏差在科技行业女性领导者中从自我评价到外部可见性的持续性影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒女性领导力演讲和活动应避免仅展示成功案例，需正视系统性性别障碍；为企业和组织制定更公平的晋升和评估机制提供依据。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12827
title: Blue Lies
affiliations: , University of Pennsylvania and Università degli Studi di Milano

detail.title: Blue Lies
detail.abstract: We introduce the “blue lies game,” a sender-receiver interaction where lying benefits both the liar and her ingroup member at the outgroup’s expense. Across 9,672 U.S. participants assigned to groups based on either random allocation or political partisanship, 38–57% of senders lie. An ingroup truth-telling norm reduces blue lies, but the same norm attributed to the outgroup has no effect or backfires among strong identifiers. Adding the option to remain silent cuts blue lies sharply and raises aggregate welfare. We structurally estimate via GMM a model that separates lying motives into monetary self-interest, ingroup loyalty, outgroup disregard, and honesty costs, and use it to quantify the welfare losses that blue lies impose. These findings have implications for understanding deception in polarized environments and designing interventions to reduce misinformation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍"蓝色谎言游戏"，发现38-57%的参与者会为ingroup利益向outgroup撒谎；ingroup诚实规范可减少谎言，但outgroup的相同规范无效甚至适得其反；沉默选项能大幅减少谎言并提高总体福利；通过结构估计分离了货币自利、群体忠诚、外群体忽视和诚实成本四种动机。
AI.research_question: 在群体竞争情境下，人们为何以及如何为了内群体利益而向外群体撒谎？不同干预手段（规范、沉默选项）能否减少这种"蓝色谎言"？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中（如政治极化环境）充斥着为了自身群体利益而对对立群体说谎的现象，但这种"蓝色谎言"的动机结构尚不清晰，需要系统识别和量化其驱动因素及福利损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 蓝色谎言（blue lies）、内群体偏袒（ingroup loyalty）、外群体忽视（outgroup disregard）、诚实成本（honesty costs）、社会规范（social norms）、沉默选项（option to remain silent）
AI.method: 实验经济学方法（9,672名美国参与者），结合随机分组和政治党派分组；结构估计（GMM）分解动机成分
AI.findings: (1) 38-57%的发送者撒谎；(2) 内群体诚实规范减少蓝色谎言，但外群体诚实规范无效甚至对强认同者有反效果；(3) 沉默选项大幅减少谎言并提高总福利；(4) 结构估计成功分离了货币自利、群体忠诚、外群体忽视和诚实成本四种动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了蓝色谎言博弈的理论框架，量化分解了驱动群体间欺骗的不同动机成分，揭示了规范来源（内群体vs外群体）对行为的不同影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解极化环境中的欺骗行为提供实证基础，为设计减少错误信息的干预措施（如提供沉默选项而非简单强调规范）提供指导。

title: Does Voluntary Certification Promote Sustainability Investment?
affiliations: Wuhan University,  and Wuhan University

detail.title: Does Voluntary Certification Promote Sustainability Investment?
detail.abstract: Despite the prevalence of third-party sustainability certification, empirical evidence on whether such certification improves actual sustainability performance remains mixed. Motivated by this puzzle, we develop a game-theoretic model in which a firm chooses whether to make a costly sustainability investment and whether to pursue certification before selling in a regulated market. Consumers observe only price and certification status, but neither the firm's investment level nor its certification attempt. Certification plays two strategic roles: signaling sustainability to consumers and helping the firm mitigate regulatory risk before market entry. We show that lowering certification cost can either encourage or discourage investment. The latter occurs when regulation is sufficiently stringent: the firm may use certification as a substitute for investment, relying on its risk-mitigation effect rather than proactively improving sustainability. Our results suggest that policymakers carefully assess the joint impact of third-party certification and the regulatory environment. When regulation is already stringent, policymakers may achieve better outcomes by improving certification accuracy and consumer awareness than by reducing certification costs.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过博弈模型分析了第三方可持续认证对企业实际可持续投资的影响，发现降低认证成本在监管严格时反而可能抑制企业投资，因为企业会用认证替代实质性改进。
AI.research_question: 第三方可持续认证是否能提升企业的实际可持续绩效？在什么条件下认证会促进或抑制企业的可持续投资？
AI.motivation: 现有关于第三方可持续认证对实际可持续绩效影响的实证证据是混合的（既有正面也有负面），这一矛盾现象缺乏理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，信号传递理论（认证向消费者传递可持续信号），监管风险缓解理论（认证帮助企业降低市场准入的监管风险）。
AI.method: 博弈论（game-theoretic modeling），企业策略选择是否进行可持续投资及是否获取认证，消费者仅观测价格和认证状态但不观测投资水平和认证尝试过程。
AI.findings: 降低认证成本可能促进也可能抑制投资；当监管足够严格时，企业会将认证作为投资的替代品，利用其风险缓解效应而非实际改进可持续性；在严格监管环境下，提高认证准确性和消费者意识比降低认证成本更有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了认证的双重战略角色（信号+风险缓解），解释了为何降低认证成本在特定条件下适得其反，丰富了可持续认证与可持续投资关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了差异化建议：在监管严格的环境中，应优先提升认证准确性和消费者意识，而非简单降低认证成本；提醒企业警惕以认证替代实质性可持续投资的陷阱。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12830
title: Taxing Wealth Unlocks Capital Gains: An Efficiency Rationale for Wealth Taxes
affiliations: University of Western Ontario, NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Business and Management Science and NHH Norwegian School of Economics

detail.title: Taxing Wealth Unlocks Capital Gains: An Efficiency Rationale for Wealth Taxes
detail.abstract: Realization-based capital income taxation generates capital lock-in because investors have an incentive to delay tax payments. This generates inefficiency as investors forgo investment opportunities that require them to realize capital gains. We show that wealth taxation can unlock capital, eliminating the distortion on investors’ portfolio choice. Moreover, wealth taxes do not distort this choice in the absence of capital income taxation. This provides an efficiency rationale for wealth taxation independent of equity: shifting revenues from capital income to wealth taxes reduces distortions on portfolio choice. We provide conditions for the optimal tax mix between capital income and wealth taxes that balance the equity gains from both taxes against efficiency losses related to savings and portfolio choices. These conditions hinge on the cross-base elasticity of capital income to wealth taxes which captures lock-in responses.

AI.tldr: 本文论证财富税能够消除资本所得税导致的“资本锁定”效应（投资者因延迟纳税而错失投资机会），从而改善投资组合选择的效率，并提出在考虑公平与效率平衡时，应将部分税收从资本所得税转向财富税。
AI.research_question: 在资本所得税导致资本锁定的情况下，财富税如何改善投资组合选择效率？最优的资本所得税与财富税组合应如何设计？
AI.motivation: 资本所得税的“实现制”征税方式导致投资者为延迟纳税而锁定资本，错失更优投资机会，产生效率损失。本文试图论证财富税可以解锁资本、改善效率，并为两种税的最优组合提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本锁定效应（capital lock-in）、投资组合选择理论、最优税收理论、跨基础弹性（cross-base elasticity）
AI.method: 理论建模，推导最优税收条件，分析资本所得税与财富税对投资组合选择和储蓄决策的扭曲效应。
AI.findings: 财富税可以解锁资本锁定效应；在没有资本所得税时财富税不会扭曲投资组合选择；将税收从资本所得税转向财富税可以减少投资组合选择的扭曲；最优税收组合取决于资本收入对财富税的跨基础弹性（捕捉锁定效应）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从效率角度为财富税提供理论依据（超越传统的公平视角）；提出资本锁定效应作为资本所得税与财富税权衡的关键机制；引入跨基础弹性概念来刻画锁定效应对最优税制的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在设计资本所得税与财富税组合时提供理论指导，指出财富税在改善投资效率方面具有独特优势，且最优税制应基于锁定效应的强度进行调整。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12828
title: Environmental Taxation and Financial Frictions in Green Lending
affiliations: and University of Bayreuth - Faculty of Law, Business and Economics

detail.title: Environmental Taxation and Financial Frictions in Green Lending
detail.abstract: We study polluting firms that require loans from a monopolistic bank to invest in abatement technology. Firms differ in the effectiveness of abatement investment, and this effectiveness is private information. The bank offers a screening contract under which high-cost firms receive too little capital and therefore emit excessively. A regulator restricted to tax policy responds by setting an environmental tax above marginal environmental damage, i.e., above the Pigouvian level. The first-best allocation can be restored by combining the Pigouvian tax, which ensures efficient abatement, with tailored, type-specific loan subsidies that correct the credit-market distortion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究污染企业需要从垄断银行贷款以投资减排技术，由于企业减排效率存在私有信息，银行通过筛选合同导致高成本企业资本不足、过度排放。最优政策是结合庇古税与定向贷款补贴，而非单纯提高税率。
AI.research_question: 在信息不对称的信贷市场中，垄断银行与异质性污染企业之间的博弈如何影响环境税的最优设定？
AI.motivation: 传统庇古税理论假设完美资本市场，但现实中企业减排投资依赖银行贷款，且银行面临企业减排效率的私有信息。这导致信贷市场扭曲与环境外部性相互交织，需要重新审视最优环境政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逆向选择模型、筛选合同理论、环境经济学中的庇古税理论
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，构建包含垄断银行、异质性污染企业、监管者三方的博弈模型，求解最优合同与最优税收政策。
AI.findings: 1. 垄断银行通过筛选合同导致高减排成本企业资本配置不足，排放过高。2. 仅用税收政策时，最优环境税率高于庇古水平（即高于边际环境损害）。3. 结合庇古税（确保有效减排）与定向贷款补贴（纠正信贷市场扭曲）可恢复第一最佳配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了环境规制理论，揭示了信贷市场信息摩擦对环境税最优水平的影响，证明在存在信贷市场扭曲时偏离庇古税是次优最优选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：在存在信贷市场摩擦时，单纯提高环境税率并非最优，应结合信贷政策（如定向贷款补贴）协同治理。

title: Necro-Visibility: Platform Infrastructure, Communicative Enclosure, and the Structural Management of Political Testimony

detail.title: Necro-Visibility: Platform Infrastructure, Communicative Enclosure, and the Structural Management of Political Testimony
detail.abstract: This paper introduces necro-visibility, a concept developed to theorise a condition specific to the platform media era: the simultaneous unprecedented digital circulation of political testimony and its infrastructural containment in ways that structurally limit its translation into sustained political consequence. The concept emerges at the intersection of Achille Mbembe’s necropolitics, Judith Butler’s framework of grievability, Jodi Dean’s communicative capitalism, and the critical political economy of platform governance. It argues that necro-visibility is produced by the convergence of three structural conditions: a geopolitical or sociopolitical threat posed by the testimony to the power formation governing dominant platform infrastructure; a testimony density threshold sufficient to require targeted platform management; and the infrastructural deniability that distinguishes algorithmic governance from classical censorship. The primary empirical case is the Palestinian testimony ecosystem during Israel’s assault on Gaza from 2023 onward, anchored in the documented circulation and simultaneous suppression of Refaat Alareer’s poem If I Must Die. The paper develops a preliminary typology of visibility conditions, including full visibility with political consequence, necro-visibility, instrumentalised visibility, pre-testimonial erasure, domestic necro-visibility, and structural invisibility, to situate the paradigm case within a broader analytical spectrum. The paper extends beyond Kelly Lewis’s platform necropolitics by theorising the simultaneous amplification and containment of testimony through a single structural mechanism, the testimony commodity cycle, and introduces communicative enclosure as the structural precondition that determines in advance which populations’ testimony can exceed the threshold required for necro-visibility to operate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"necrov-visibility"（死亡见证可见性）概念，用于解释平台媒体时代政治见证被空前放大传播的同时，又被基础设施性地限制其转化为持久政治后果的矛盾现象。该概念以巴勒斯坦见证生态为实证案例，揭示了平台算法治理下"可见性"的复杂政治逻辑。
AI.research_question: 在平台媒体时代，政治见证的大规模数字传播为何难以转化为持续的政治后果？平台治理如何同时实现见证的放大与封堵？
AI.motivation: 既有的平台政治学研究多聚焦内容审查或算法放大，但缺乏一个能够解释见证同时被"传播"和"遏制"的结构性理论概念。本文试图弥补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融合了Achille Mbembe的死亡政治学、Judith Butler的可哀悼性框架、Jodi Dean的沟通资本主义以及平台治理的政治经济学批评，在Kelly Lewis的平台死亡政治学基础上进一步拓展。
AI.method: 概念化理论建构，以2023年以来以色列对加沙袭击期间巴勒斯坦见证生态系统为主要实证案例，特别是Refaat Alareer诗歌《如果我必须死》的传播与压制过程。
AI.findings: 死亡见证可见性由三种结构性条件共同产生：1）见证对主导平台基础设施的权力结构构成地缘政治或社会政治威胁；2）见证密度达到需要平台针对性管理的阈值；3）基础设施的可否认性——算法治理区别于经典审查的核心特征。此外，论文提出"见证商品循环"作为同时放大与遏制的结构性机制，并引入"沟通封闭"概念作为决定哪些群体的见证能够进入死亡见证可见性阈值的结构性前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"死亡见证可见性"概念，超越了Kelly Lewis的平台死亡政治学；2）提出"见证商品循环"机制解释平台同时放大与遏制见证的矛盾；3）提出"沟通封闭"概念揭示结构性不平等如何前置地决定了哪些群体的见证可以被看见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解平台媒体时代政治见证的传播困境提供了分析框架，帮助识别在算法治理下哪些人群的死亡与苦难能够获得可见性、哪些被结构性排除，对数字人权与平台问责具有启示意义。

title: The Niche as Necropolis: Capitalism, the Sub-Blogger, and the Death of the Symbolic Mother
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Niche as Necropolis: Capitalism, the Sub-Blogger, and the Death of the Symbolic Mother
detail.abstract: There is a particular kind of violence that announces itself as liberation, and the contemporary cult of "nishevost'" -- "nicheness," that untranslatable Russian-language term denoting the cultivated, marketable peculiarity of a personal brand -- is perhaps the purest specimen of this genre currently in circulation. The lecture series "Nishevost': kak kapitalizm nauchilsya prodavat' individual'nost'" (Nicheness: How Capitalism Learned to Sell Individuality), produced by the platform "Pravoye Polushariye Introverta" (The Introvert's Right Hemisphere), promises its viewers an answer to "how 'nicheness' makes everyone the same," framed explicitly against Thorstein Veblen's Theory of the Leisure Class and against the sociology of culture more broadly. The advertisement copy is a small masterpiece of unintentional irony: it sells, for free and without registration, a critique of the very mechanism by which it sells itself -- the cultivation of a niche audience (introverts, specifically, that most commodifiable of contemporary identities) through the promise of exclusive insight into how commodification works. This is not a contradiction so much as a structural truth laid bare: the critique of niche capitalism is itself the most lucrative niche available. Veblen (1899/2007) understood conspicuous consumption as a status game played by the leisure class to distinguish itself from labor; what the platform's blurb gestures toward, without quite arriving, is the inversion Veblen could not have anticipated -- a status game in which the commodity being conspicuously consumed is not a top hat or a yacht but the buyer's own unrepeatable interior life, hawked back to her in the form of a Telegram channel subscription.

AI.tldr: 本文剖析了当代俄罗斯互联网平台上"尼切沃斯特"（nicheness/无特性）现象——一种以"解放"为名、实则将个人独特性商品化的新型暴力。通过分析一个向内向者出售"如何理解资本主义售卖个性"的免费讲座，揭示了批判商品化本身已成为最赚钱的利基市场这一结构性真相，并与凡勃伦的炫耀性消费理论形成对话：当消费的奢侈品变成了买家自己的内心生活时，凡勃伦的框架发生了倒置。
AI.research_question: 当代"利基性"（nicheness）作为一种自我标榜的个性商品化现象，其运行机制是什么？它如何通过对商品化的批判来完成更高级的商品化？
AI.motivation: 当代资本主义已经进化到能够将"独特性"本身作为商品来生产和销售，而最有力的证据是：对利基资本主义的批判本身已经成为最有利可图的利基市场。这一悖论值得理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凡勃伦的炫耀性消费理论（地位游戏模型）；布尔迪厄的文化资本/区隔理论（隐含）；商品化批判的元批判（自我指涉性）
AI.method: 文本分析（广告文案分析）；理论对话（与凡勃伦的跨时空对话）；结构性批判（揭示平台自身运作逻辑与所售内容之间的同构关系）
AI.findings: 1. 利基资本主义的核心机制是：将"个性"本身包装为稀缺商品，卖给渴望通过消费获得身份认同的群体（此处为"内向者"）。2. 对商品化的批判（免费讲座）本身即是一种利基营销——它通过提供"独家洞见"来制造新的身份区隔。3. 凡勃伦所描述的"显性消费"发生了倒置：被消费的不再是物质奢侈品，而是消费者自己的"不可复制的内心生活"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将凡勃伦的炫耀性消费理论延伸至后物质时代——当消费对象从"物"变为"自我"时，地位游戏的规则发生了根本变化。2. 揭示了"批判与商品化"之间的同构关系：对资本主义的批判本身可以被资本主义吸收为一种新的商品形式。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示当代知识消费者：当你在消费"如何抵抗商品化"的内容时，你很可能已经陷入了更深层次的商品化。对任何标榜"独特"、"小众"、"反主流"的文化产品保持结构性警惕。

title: The Tamagotchi Economy: Niche, Lipstick, and the Gendered Spectacle of Post-Soviet Platform Capitalism
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Tamagotchi Economy: Niche, Lipstick, and the Gendered Spectacle of Post-Soviet Platform Capitalism
detail.abstract: Somewhere between a TikTok ring light and a Telegram paywall, a new anthropological subject has crystallized: the woman who pays a stranger forty dollars a month for the privilege of watching her buy a handbag. She is not deceived. She knows the blogger is not her friend. She knows the "personal growth" coaching call is dramaturgy, that the tearful confession on a Zoom screen is blocked out like a soap opera beat, that the influencer's villa in five hundred near-identical Reels is rented for the afternoon. And she pays anyway — not despite the fiction, but because of it. This essay begins from that paradox, because it is the paradox on which an entire economy now runs: an economy of niches, lipsticks, tamagotchis, and borrowed children, in which capitalism has discovered that the most profitable commodity left to sell is the self, packaged, narrated, and sold back to its owner in dazzling, deniable fragments. The five fragments of vernacular cultural criticism that occasion this essay — circulating, as such things now do, as Telegram chat logs, half-finished video essays, and recession-economics trivia — describe what looks, at first glance, like five unrelated phenomena. There is the "lipstick index," the durable folk-economic claim that cosmetics sales rise in a recession. There is the cult of "nicheness," the contemporary mania for curating an identity so particular that mass culture cannot touch it. There is the blogger as "tamagotchi," the paid intimacy economy in which a poor subscriber buys five vicarious lives from a rich one. There is "Kaptsova," a composite figure for the female life-coach-cum-romance-simulator who monetizes loneliness through Zoom calls that blur coaching, therapy, and webcam intimacy, sometimes with an undertow of submission and humiliation. And there is the unnamed "sugar mommy," the woman who satisfies a narcissistic and quasi-maternal hunger by lavishing status goods on someone else's child, all while society reserves its moral alarm for men. I will argue across the length of this essay that these are not five phenomena but one: a single libidinal-economic structure in which the gendered self is dismantled into purchasable units of attention, taste, intimacy, and care, and reassembled as a product line.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了一种当代资本主义新形态：女性消费者明知博主并非朋友、内容经过编排，却仍付费观看博主购买奢侈品、参与“个人成长”辅导等，因为正是这种虚构性而非真相驱动了消费。文章将口红指数、小众崇拜、博主作为电子宠物、Kaptsova式情感教练、以及“糖妈”现象统合为一个单一的力比多-经济结构，在此结构中，性别化的自我被拆解为可购买的单位（注意力、品味、亲密感、关怀）并重新组装为产品线。
AI.research_question: 当代资本主义如何通过将性别化的自我拆解为可购买的注意力、品味、亲密感和关怀单元，并重新组装为产品线，从而构建一个以虚构性为核心的力比多-经济结构？
AI.motivation: 作者注意到一个悖论：消费者明知博主内容具有虚构性和表演性（如租用别墅拍摄Reels、情感教练的眼泪如同肥皂剧桥段），却仍然付费消费。这一悖论构成了整个新兴经济的基础，值得深入分析其背后的结构性逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 力比多经济（libidinal economy）、性别化的自我商品化、虚构性商品化、注意力经济与亲密关系商品化
AI.method: 碎片化文化批评（vernacular cultural criticism），通过分析五种看似无关的现象（口红指数、小众崇拜、博主作为电子宠物、Kaptsova式情感教练、糖妈现象）进行综合理论论证。
AI.findings: 这五种现象并非独立的，而是同一力比多-经济结构的不同表现：资本主义发现最有利可图的商品是“自我”——将其包装、叙事化，并以令人目眩的、可否认的碎片形式卖回给所有者。性别化的自我被系统地拆解为可购买的单位，再重新组装为产品线。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合性的分析框架，将看似分散的消费现象（口红指数、小众身份、付费亲密关系、情感教练、糖妈）纳入统一的力比多-经济结构中，揭示了资本主义如何系统性地商品化性别化的自我。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代网络消费、网红经济、付费亲密关系等新兴经济形态提供了批判性分析视角，揭示了这些现象背后共同的结构性逻辑，有助于对资本如何利用性别、亲密关系与虚构性进行深度反思。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12826
title: Growth and Debt Sustainability Trade-offs in the Presence of Climate Shocks and Uncertainties
affiliations: , World Bank, World Bank and World Bank

detail.title: Growth and Debt Sustainability Trade-offs in the Presence of Climate Shocks and Uncertainties
detail.abstract: Climate shocks create a difficult policy problem: an intervention that protects growth can also strain public finances, and these trade-offs are magnified by uncertainty about both the shocks themselves and the macroeconomic model used to assess them. In this paper, a methodology to explore these issues is presented and applied to the management of coastal flood risks in the Maldives. The analysis uses a version of the World Bank MFMod macrostructural model that includes stochastic damages from coastal flood and model uncertainty. It evaluates two policy options (prevention and preparedness) using three metrics: expected GDP losses, the probability that debt exceeds a sustainability threshold, and the probability of a sharp deterioration in the debt ratio. Results show that climate risks are macro-critical in the Maldives and that individual policies create synergies and trade-offs. Investments in prevention are win-win, with gains in GDP enhancing debt sustainability, but only up to a certain level. Beyond a threshold, there is a trade-off between growth and debt sustainability as debt-financed prevention investments worsen debt vulnerabilities in spite of the GDP gains they generate. Preparedness alone (through contingency funds or other instruments) improves fiscal resilience, especially in context of large tail risks. Policy mixes mitigate trade-offs and preparedness and prevention are complement: preparedness enables larger prevention investments without magnifying debt vulnerability, leading to larger GDP gains. Introducing model uncertainty widens the distribution of possible outcomes but does not affect key policy conclusions. The main policy message is that robust climate macrofiscal planning should move beyond expected values and focus on policy mixes that combine prevention and preparedness to manage growth and debt sustainability across a wide range of plausible futures.

AI.tldr: 本文以马尔代夫沿海洪灾风险为例，研究了气候冲击下预防与准备两种政策组合对经济增长与债务可持续性的影响，发现预防投资在一定阈值内是双赢的，超过阈值则会产生增长与债务可持续性之间的权衡，而准备措施能增强财政韧性，政策组合能有效缓解权衡并产生互补效应。
AI.research_question: 在气候冲击背景下，不同的政策选项（预防与准备）如何影响经济增长与债务可持续性？政策组合能否缓解二者之间的权衡？模型不确定性是否会改变关键政策结论？
AI.motivation: 气候冲击会创造棘手的政策困境：保护增长的措施可能加剧财政压力，且气候冲击本身和宏观经济模型的不确定性使这一权衡更加复杂。现有研究缺乏对这一动态权衡的系统性量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于世界银行MFMod宏观结构模型，纳入沿海洪灾的随机损害和模型不确定性，结合债务可持续性框架进行政策评估。
AI.method: 使用包含随机气候损害和模型不确定性的MFMod宏观结构模型，对两种政策选项（预防和准备）进行评估。采用三个指标：预期GDP损失、债务超过可持续阈值的概率、债务比率急剧恶化的概率。
AI.findings: 1）气候风险对马尔代夫具有宏观关键性；2）预防投资在一定阈值内是双赢的，能同时促进GDP增长和债务可持续性，但超过阈值后会产生增长与债务可持续性之间的权衡；3）准备措施（如应急基金）能改善财政韧性，尤其在尾部风险较大的情况下；4）政策组合能缓解权衡，预防与准备具有互补性；5）模型不确定性会扩大可能结果的分布范围，但不影响关键政策结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了气候适应政策中增长与债务可持续性之间的非线性权衡关系，并证明了模型不确定性不会改变稳健政策结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为马尔代夫及类似小岛屿发展中国家提供了气候宏观财政规划的政策框架，强调应关注政策组合而非单一政策，并超越期望值思维，管理多种未来情景下的增长与债务可持续性。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12829
title: Machine Learning and Liquidity Dynamics in European Stock Markets
affiliations: Council of Economic Advisors, Ministry of Finance, Hellenic Republic, Brunel University London - Department of Economics and Finance and

detail.title: Machine Learning and Liquidity Dynamics in European Stock Markets
detail.abstract: This paper examines the forecasting of liquidity dynamics in European stock markets by means of traditional econometric models and machine learning techniques. It uses daily data for the DAX, CAC 40, FTSE 100, FTSE MIB, and IBEX 35 over 2010–2026, liquidity being measured by the logarithmic Amihud illiquidity indicator. The empirical framework compares ARIMA models and a dynamic panel specification with Random Forest, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and Support Vector Regression (SVR) within a common rolling one-step-ahead forecasting framework. The results show that liquidity is highly persistent and that the dynamic panel model achieves the lowest forecast errors, although Diebold–Mariano tests indicate no significant predictive advantage over the leading machine learning models. SHAP analysis reveals that trading activity, lagged liquidity, and market uncertainty are the main determinants of liquidity forecasts. The findings highlight the complementary role of explainable machine learning in empirical finance.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了传统计量模型（ARIMA、动态面板）与机器学习（随机森林、XGBoost、SVR）在欧洲股票市场流动性预测中的表现，发现动态面板模型误差最低，但机器学习模型并无显著统计劣势，SHAP分析揭示了流动性的关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 如何利用传统计量模型和机器学习技术有效预测欧洲股票市场的流动性动态？
AI.motivation: 流动性是金融市场效率的关键指标，但对其预测方法的系统性比较研究不足，尤其是传统模型与可解释机器学习方法的对比。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性持续性理论、Amihud非流动性指标、动态面板数据模型、集成学习与支持向量回归理论。
AI.method: 使用2010–2026年DAX、CAC 40、FTSE 100、FTSE MIB、IBEX 35的日度数据，以对数Amihud非流动性指标衡量流动性。对比ARIMA、动态面板模型与随机森林、XGBoost、SVR，采用滚动一步预测框架，并用Diebold–Mariano检验和SHAP分析进行评估。
AI.findings: 流动性高度持续；动态面板模型预测误差最低，但Diebold–Mariano检验显示其与领先机器学习模型无显著统计差异；SHAP分析表明交易活动、滞后流动性和市场不确定性是流动性预测的主要决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统比较了传统计量模型与可解释机器学习在流动性预测中的表现，揭示了二者在预测精度上的互补性，拓展了流动性预测的方法论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者和监管机构提供了流动性预测的模型选择依据；SHAP分析帮助识别关键预测因子，有助于风险管理和市场微观结构设计。

title: When Regulators Overlap: Fragmented Regulation and Corporate Environmental Footprints
affiliations: Northern Trust Corporation - Northern Trust Asset Management, Vietnam National University - Ho Chi Minh City (VNU-HCM), University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City and Griffith University - Griffith Business School

detail.title: When Regulators Overlap: Fragmented Regulation and Corporate Environmental Footprints
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether regulatory fragmentation affects corporate carbon emissions. Using U.S firms from 2003 to 2023, this paper confirms that firms exposed to greater fragmentation across federal regulators generate higher carbon emissions. The effect is economically meaningful and robust across a battery of robustness checks. We further show that regulatory fragmentation operates through weakened corporate carbon reduction initiatives, including emission-reduction policies and targets. The effect is weaker when firms have stronger sustainability governance and external monitoring. Overall, the findings reveal an unintended carbon cost of fragmented regulatory oversight.

AI.tldr: 研究监管碎片化对企业碳排放的影响，发现联邦监管机构越分散，企业碳排放越高，这一效应通过弱化企业减排措施实现，且受到公司治理和外部监督的调节。
AI.research_question: 监管碎片化是否会影响企业的碳排放水平？
AI.motivation: 现有文献较少关注监管架构碎片化对企业环境绩效的潜在负面影响，本研究旨在揭示监管碎片化作为一种制度性因素如何影响企业碳排放。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管碎片化理论、企业碳减排行为理论、公司治理与外部监督理论。
AI.method: 以2003-2023年美国企业为样本，采用实证回归分析，通过多项稳健性检验验证结果可靠性。
AI.findings: （1）联邦监管机构碎片化程度越高，企业碳排放越高；（2）监管碎片化通过削弱企业减排政策与目标等碳减排举措发挥作用；（3）更强的可持续治理和外部监督能缓解这一负面效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从监管碎片化视角揭示制度性因素对企业碳排放的影响机制，拓展了监管碎片化经济后果及企业碳减排驱动因素的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者优化监管架构、减少碎片化提供实证依据；提示企业加强可持续治理和外部监督以对冲监管碎片化的负面效应。

title: Combining Parimutuel Settlement with Automated Market Makers for Liquidity-Guaranteed Prediction Markets: The Onix Protocol

detail.title: Combining Parimutuel Settlement with Automated Market Makers for Liquidity-Guaranteed Prediction Markets: The Onix Protocol

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no conflicts of interest relevant to this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or personal data, and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Prediction markets aggregate dispersed information into probabilistic forecasts that consistently outperform polls and expert panels, yet their adoption is constrained by a structural liquidity problem: providers of market depth bear adverse selection risk that deters retail participation. We present the Onix Protocol, a hybrid architecture that decouples the pricing function from the settlement function in prediction markets. By pairing automated market maker pricing-a Constant Product Market Maker (CPMM) for binary outcomes and a Logarithmic Market Scoring Rule (LMSR) for multi-outcome markets-with parimutuel (totalizator) settlement, we achieve a structural guarantee that liquidity-provider principal is never at risk from betting outcomes. We formalize the protocol's economic invariants, prove the LP principal guarantee for both market types, describe a "Lazy" liquidity pool enabling passive retail participation, analyze the dispute resolution mechanism under DAO governance, and discuss the experimental hypotheses this system is designed to test. The protocol is implemented as consensus-level operations on the VIZ distributed ledger.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Onix协议，通过将定价函数与结算函数解耦（使用CPMM/LMSR定价 + 彩池结算），在预测市场中实现流动性提供者本金不受投注结果影响的结构性保障，并已在VIZ分布式账本上实现。
AI.research_question: 如何通过协议架构设计，解决预测市场中因逆向选择导致的流动性结构性不足问题？
AI.motivation: 预测市场在信息聚合上显著优于民意调查和专家小组，但流动性提供者因承担逆向选择风险而参与不足，限制了预测市场的广泛采用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自动做市商定价理论（CPMM用于二元市场，LMSR用于多结果市场）；彩池结算机制的经济学原理；DAO治理下的争议解决机制。
AI.method: 协议设计与形式化分析：定义Onix协议的经济不变量，证明两类市场下流动性提供者本金保护定理，描述"懒惰"流动性池设计，分析DAO争议解决机制，并在VIZ分布式账本上实现为共识层操作。
AI.findings: 提出混合架构将定价与结算功能解耦，结构性保证LP本金不受投注结果影响；证明了二元市场（CPMM）和多结果市场（LMSR）下的LP本金保护定理；设计了支持被动零售参与的"懒惰"流动性池。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了预测市场中定价函数与结算函数解耦的经济不变量，首次从理论上证明了在混合架构下LP本金的结构性保护。
AI.practical_contributions: Onix协议为预测市场提供了可落地的流动性解决方案，通过"懒惰"流动性池降低零售参与门槛，通过DAODAO治理解决争议，已在VIZ区块链上实现。

title: The Forgotten Core of the Father of Strategic Management: Revisiting the Ansoff-Mintzberg Debate and the Strategic Success Hypothesis Purpose
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice, Department of Management, Students

detail.title: The Forgotten Core of the Father of Strategic Management: Revisiting the Ansoff-Mintzberg Debate and the Strategic Success Hypothesis Purpose
detail.abstract: This paper reconstructs the Ansoff-Mintzberg exchange as a historically significant contingency truce rather than a winner-loser outcome. It argues that the debate's enduring legacy is the unresolved question of strategic correctness: when firms should converge toward prevailing industry norms and when they should diverge in pursuit of strategic becoming. From this perspective, the paper repositions Igor Ansoff as a pioneer whose most consequential contribution-the Strategic Success Hypothesis (SSH)-was gradually marginalized, fragmented in later research and left only partially validated for decades.

AI.tldr: 本文重新解读了Ansoff与Mintzberg之间的经典争论，认为这是一场具有历史意义的“权宜休战”而非胜负分明的对决。争论的核心遗产是战略正确性这一未解问题：企业何时应趋同于行业规范，何时应追求差异化。文章将Ansoff重新定位为先驱，其最重要的贡献——战略成功假说（SSH）——逐渐被边缘化、碎片化，数十年来仅得到部分验证。
AI.research_question: Ansoff与Mintzberg争论的历史本质是什么？战略成功假说（SSH）为何被边缘化且未被充分验证？
AI.motivation: 重新审视Ansoff-Mintzberg争论的历史意义，纠正将其视为“赢家vs输家”的简化叙事，并恢复Ansoff的战略成功假说（SSH）在战略管理领域的应有地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略成功假说（Strategic Success Hypothesis, SSH）；战略趋同与战略差异化（战略正确性）之间的张力；权变理论视角下的学术争论分析。
AI.method: 历史重构与概念分析，对Ansoff-Mintzberg争论及其后续研究影响进行追溯性梳理。
AI.findings: Ansoff-Mintzberg争论并非胜负之争，而是一场“权宜休战”；其核心遗产是战略正确性（何时趋同、何时差异化）这一未解问题；SSH被边缘化、碎片化，仅得到部分验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了Ansoff-Mintzberg争论的历史性质；恢复了Ansoff作为战略管理先驱的地位；揭示了SSH被忽视的理论价值及其未完成的验证议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示管理者和学者关注战略正确性的核心问题：企业在何时应遵循行业规范，何时应主动进行战略差异化。

title: The Role of Arrival-Rate Uncertainty in Priority Queues
affiliations: , Hebrew University of Jerusalem and Hebrew University of Jerusalem

detail.title: The Role of Arrival-Rate Uncertainty in Priority Queues
detail.abstract: We study priority pricing in an unobservable single-server queue when customers commit to purchasing priority before the arrival rate is revealed. Because a customer is more likely to arrive when the arrival rate is high, fully rational customers assign greater weight to higharrival-rate realizations, whereas naive customers continue to use the prior distribution. Since the value of priority increases with congestion, naive customers systematically underestimate that value and consequently have a lower willingness to pay. We show that this belief distortion determines the value of pricing flexibility. A fixed price is simple to implement, but may leave customers paying more for priority than the reduction in waiting costs it ultimately provides, an outcome we refer to as ex-post regret. It also generates lower revenue when customers are naive. Rate-contingent pricing provides a robust benchmark that eliminates regret and is unaffected by the customers' rationality level. More aggressive rate-contingent pricing can extract additional revenue from naive customers, but sacrifices robustness and may increase regret. A full refund policy also eliminates regret, but at a revenue cost. The analysis reveals a trade-off between revenue extraction, robustness, customer regret, and implementation simplicity under arrival-rate uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 研究当顾客在到达率未知前承诺购买优先权时，单服务器队列中的优先定价问题。理性顾客高估高到达率情景，而天真顾客低估优先权价值。不同定价策略在收益、稳健性、顾客后悔和实现简易性之间存在权衡。
AI.research_question: 在到达率不确定且顾客需提前承诺购买优先权的情景下，不同定价策略（固定价格、费率依赖定价、激进费率依赖定价、全额退款政策）如何影响收益、顾客后悔和稳健性？
AI.motivation: 现实中许多排队系统（如机场安检、客服热线）的到达率具有不确定性，而顾客需提前决定是否购买优先权。现有文献忽略到达率不确定性对优先权定价的影响，以及顾客理性程度差异带来的行为效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性预期理论、主观概率加权、排队博弈理论、行为经济学中的天真与理性顾客模型。
AI.method: 数学模型分析，建立单服务器不可观察队列的优先定价模型，比较不同类型顾客（理性vs天真）在不同定价策略下的均衡行为。
AI.findings: 1. 天真顾客系统性低估优先权价值，支付意愿低于理性顾客。2. 固定价格简单但可能导致顾客事后后悔（支付的费用高于等待成本减少值），且在天真顾客场景下收益更低。3. 费率依赖定价（rate-contingent pricing）消除后悔、不受顾客理性水平影响，是稳健基准。4. 更激进的费率依赖定价可从天真顾客处提取更多收益，但牺牲稳健性、增加后悔。5. 全额退款政策消除后悔但有收益成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 将到达率不确定性引入优先定价研究，揭示顾客信念扭曲（对高到达率情景的加权差异）如何影响定价策略效果，丰富了排队经济学和行为运筹学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务运营管理者在到达率不确定环境下设计优先权定价策略提供指导，帮助理解固定价格、费率依赖定价、退款政策等不同方案在收益、顾客满意度和实施复杂度之间的权衡取舍。

title: Saturation Room and Firm Value: A Valuation Framework for AI-Native Firms
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Saturation Room and Firm Value: A Valuation Framework for AI-Native Firms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. This is an independent, unfunded, pure-theory working paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a pure-theory paper involving no human participants, animal subjects, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding. It was conducted by the author as an independent researcher.

detail.abstract: Building on the saturation-decoupling theorem of Paper I, this paper addresses a valuation question: when a firm's value comes from unrealized saturation room—the gap between coverage x and its ceiling x̄—rather than from current cash flow, how should it be valued? Our central result is a misspecification-cost theorem (Proposition 1): any valuation that extrapolates from observed cash flow without explicitly modeling the coverage path x → x̄ underestimates such firms by an amount that is strictly positive and increases monotonically in the distance to saturation; a correctly specified path-forecasting valuation recovers true value exactly. The underestimation is therefore not a property of discounting but of anchoring. We then define FACE, a valuation re-anchored on net-worth accumulation (N, assets minus liabilities on a non-monetary balance sheet), and prove a consistency result (Proposition 3): under a stated parameterization the FACE compounding form agrees with true value to first order, with its gap from cash-flow-anchored DCF equal to the present value of saturation room. Finally, we derive the value–cash-flow lead–lag from an explicit two-rate dynamical system in which execution accumulates exponentially while monetization relaxes toward an Amdahl ceiling at a bandwidth-limited rate; the lead is obtained in closed form and is positive exactly when judgment bandwidth binds (Proposition 4). This is pure theory; we report no empirics but provide a refutable interface with operational proxies.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，若企业价值源于未实现的饱和空间（覆盖率与天花板之间的差距），则基于现金流外推的估值会系统性地低估企业价值；作者提出FACE估值法（基于净资产积累重锚定），并推导出价值-现金流的领先-滞后关系，在判断带宽受限时领先为正。
AI.research_question: 当企业价值主要来自未实现的饱和空间（覆盖率x与天花板x̄之间的差距）而非当前现金流时，应如何估值？
AI.motivation: 现有估值方法大多基于当前现金流外推，但许多高成长企业的价值实际上源于未达到饱和的增长空间。本文旨在建立一种能够捕捉这种"饱和空间"价值的理论估值框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 饱和-解耦定理（Paper I）、错误设定成本定理、路径预测估值、FACE估值法（基于净资产积累重锚定）、双率动力系统（执行指数积累vs货币化以带宽受限速率向Amdahl天花板松弛）。
AI.method: 纯理论研究，推导命题1（错误设定成本定理）、命题3（FACE估值一致性结果）、命题4（价值-现金流领先-滞后关系的闭合形式解）。
AI.findings: (1) 任何基于现金流外推而不显式建模覆盖率路径的估值方法，都会系统地低估存在饱和空间的企业，低估量随距饱和距离严格递增；(2) FACE估值法在给定参数化下与真实价值一阶一致，与现金流锚定DCF的差额等于饱和空间的现值；(3) 在判断带宽约束下，价值领先于现金流（领先为正）。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出错误设定成本定理，首次严格证明现金流外推法对饱和空间企业的系统低估；(2) 提出FACE估值法，为高成长型企业的估值提供新的理论锚点；(3) 从双率动力系统推导出价值-现金流领先-滞后关系的闭合形式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可反驳的实证接口（与运营代理变量对应），为实务中评估那些当前现金流小但增长潜力大的企业（如科技初创公司）提供了理论指导。

title: Powertrain Portfolio Under Discrete Choice Model: A Deep Reinforce Learning Method
affiliations: Tianjin University of Finance and Economics, Tianjin University of Finance and Economics, Tianjin University of Finance & Economics and Tianjin University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Powertrain Portfolio Under Discrete Choice Model: A Deep Reinforce Learning Method
detail.abstract: This paper examines strategic powertrain transition and compliance management under China's Dual-Credit Policy, characterized by endogenous demand-technology-regulation co-evolution. We formulate a Markov Decision Process (MDP) framework with Multinomial Logit (MNL) demand to jointly optimize RD investment, pricing, and compliance credit trading and banking decisions across diverse new energy vehicle (NEV) and conventional fuel vehicle (CFV) offerings. Since high-dimensional continuous states and nonlinear MNL choice probabilities preclude closed-form solutions, we develop a CSAC-DualCredit algorithm as the solver. Findings show that: (1) electric range amplifies while conventional fuel vehicle fuel consumption attenuates profit sensitivity to credit prices; (2) optimal pricing favors NEVs only when consumer price sensitivity exceeds a threshold, reflecting underlying technological diversity; and (3) the algorithm guarantees feasibility without sacrificing exploration. Numerical results offer actionable strategies for navigating coupled transitions under volatile regulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国双积分政策下，企业如何通过马尔可夫决策过程框架，联合优化研发投资、定价和合规积分交易/存储决策，以实现动力系统战略转型与合规管理。提出了CSAC-DualCredit算法求解高维连续状态空间问题，发现了电动续航、燃油消耗对利润敏感性的影响机制，以及最优定价偏向新能源车的阈值条件。
AI.research_question: 在需求-技术-监管共同演化的环境下，中国双积分政策下汽车企业如何制定最优的动力系统转型策略（包括研发投资、定价和合规积分交易/存储决策）？
AI.motivation: 双积分政策下，企业面临燃油车与新能源车的复杂合规管理问题，需要同时考虑内生需求、技术选择和动态监管的协同演化，现有研究缺乏对这一联合优化问题的系统性建模与求解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）、多元Logit（MNL）需求模型、CSAC（连续状态-动作约束）强化学习算法
AI.method: 构建MDP-MNL联合优化框架，开发CSAC-DualCredit算法求解高维连续状态和MNL非线性选择概率带来的复杂优化问题。
AI.findings: （1）电动续航里程放大利润对积分价格的敏感性，而燃油车油耗则减弱这种敏感性；（2）只有当消费者价格敏感度超过某一阈值时，最优定价才会偏向新能源车，这反映了底层技术多样性；（3）CSAC-DualCredit算法在保证可行性的同时不牺牲探索能力。
