title: Off-Label, On Air: Direct-to-Consumer Advertising and GLP-1 Drug Allocation
affiliations: University of Rochester - Simon Business School,  and Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School

detail.title: Off-Label, On Air: Direct-to-Consumer Advertising and GLP-1 Drug Allocation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how direct-to-consumer advertising (DTCA) shapes off-label demand for semaglutide. Although semaglutide was initially approved for type 2 diabetes under the brand name Ozempic, its DTCA promoted weight-loss benefits prior to FDA approval of semaglutide for weight management. Using granular prescription and medical claims data from a large sample of commercially-insured individuals, we estimate the effects of DTCA on demand across medical conditions, before and after clinical validation of the weight-management use case. We find that DTCA increases off-label initiation prior to clinical validation, both among individuals without relevant diagnoses and, more strongly, among high BMI individuals, for whom use was later approved. DTCA effects strengthen as clinical evidence accumulates, as does baseline treatment initiation, suggesting the lessening of access frictions. Differential DTCA responses across insurance plans indicate that patients with more generous coverage are better able to convert DTCA-driven interest into initiation, implying greater DTCA-induced exposure to both the potential benefits and risks of early off-label adoption. Overall, our results show that DTCA can accelerate the diffusion of off-label use before formal approval, while providers and insurers shape the distribution of advertising-induced off-label demand.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了直接面向消费者的广告（DTCA）如何影响司美格鲁肽的超适应症需求，发现DTCA在临床验证前显著增加了超适应症用药，且商业保险覆盖更慷慨的患者更容易将广告驱动的兴趣转化为实际用药。
AI.research_question: 直接面向消费者的广告（DTCA）如何塑造司美格鲁肽在正式获批前的超适应症需求？
AI.motivation: 司美格鲁肽（Ozempic）最初获批用于2型糖尿病，但其DTCA在FDA正式批准减肥适应症之前就已推广减重益处，这为研究DTCA如何影响超适应症用药提供了独特的自然实验场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息扩散理论、消费者行为理论、保险覆盖与医疗可及性理论
AI.method: 利用大规模商业保险人群的处方和医疗索赔微观数据，估计DTCA对不同医疗条件下需求的影响，比较临床验证前后的效果差异。
AI.findings: 1) DTCA在临床验证前显著增加了超适应症用药，尤其在高BMI人群（后续获批人群）中效果更强；2) 随着临床证据积累，DTCA效应和基线治疗启动均增强，表明获取障碍降低；3) 保险覆盖更慷慨的患者更容易将DTCA驱动的兴趣转化为实际用药。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了DTCA在正式监管批准前加速超适应症用药扩散的机制，拓展了药企营销与药品需求创造关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构制定DTCA政策提供实证依据，提示需关注广告驱动的超适应症用药风险；为医保支付方设计药品覆盖方案提供参考。

title: A Reference Architecture for Agentic Data Quality in Microsoft Fabric and Azure

detail.title: A Reference Architecture for Agentic Data Quality in Microsoft Fabric and Azure
detail.abstract: Enterprise data pipelines are increasingly exposed to schema drift, incomplete metadata, statistical anomalies, ambiguous business semantics, and growing operational cost. Conventional rule-based validation remains essential because it is deterministic and auditable, but it becomes expensive to maintain when data sources and business definitions change frequently. Large language models can interpret contextual descriptions and propose mappings or explanations, yet their probabilistic outputs introduce hallucination, privacy, and governance risks. This paper presents a reference architecture for agentic data quality in Microsoft Fabric and Azure that combines deterministic Python and PySpark validation with a bounded Llama-family reasoning layer, structured agent-to-agent communication, and human-in-the-loop review. The design separates structural, statistical, semantic, policy, and governance checks; routes only ambiguous exceptions to an AI model; and records every decision, evidence item, rule version, and reviewer action. Microsoft Fabric provides orchestration, notebooks, OneLake storage, lakehouse tables, semantic models, and reporting, while Azure services provide schema management, event-driven coordination, secrets management, observability, and optional model hosting. The paper does not claim production-scale benchmark results. Instead, it contributes a precise architecture, decision policy, threat model, cost model, and reproducible proof-of-concept protocol using a public retail customer dataset with injected quality faults. The central design principle is controlled autonomy: AI may recommend and explain, but deterministic gates and accountable humans retain authority over high-impact data decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合确定性验证（Python/PySpark）与受限AI推理（Llama模型）的参考架构，用于Microsoft Fabric和Azure环境下的数据质量管控，核心原则是“受控自主”——AI可建议和解释，但确定性规则和人机协同保留最终决策权。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种混合架构，在利用LLM的语义理解能力处理数据质量异常的同时，避免其幻觉和隐私风险，并保持确定性验证的可审计性？
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则的验证在数据源和业务定义频繁变化时维护成本高昂，而纯LLM方法存在幻觉、隐私和治理风险，亟需一种兼顾两者优点的可控架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 受控自主（Controlled Autonomy）设计原则；分层验证框架（结构、统计、语义、策略、治理五层分离）；智能体间结构化通信（Agent-to-Agent Communication）
AI.method: 提出参考架构与决策策略，包含：确定性Python/PySpark验证层 + 受限Llama推理层 + 智能体通信 + 人工复核回路；在Microsoft Fabric和Azure上构建原型，使用公开零售数据集注入质量缺陷进行概念验证。
AI.findings: 确定性规则处理常规校验，仅将歧义异常路由至AI模型；所有决策、证据、规则版本和审核操作均被记录；架构包含威胁模型和成本模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“受控自主”这一数据质量治理设计原则；构建了结构化智能体间通信与分层验证相结合的理论框架；提供了可复现的概念验证协议。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Microsoft Fabric和Azure生态提供了一套完整的数据质量参考架构，包含决策策略、威胁模型、成本模型和可复现的PoC方案，可直接指导企业级数据管道质量管控的实施。

title: Fuzzy and Configurational Approaches to Generative-AI Adoption: A UTAUT2 Systematic Review

detail.title: Fuzzy and Configurational Approaches to Generative-AI Adoption: A UTAUT2 Systematic Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. This research is a systematic review of previously published studies and did not involve any new data collection from human participants or animals
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has rapidly moved from novelty to an everyday tool, and understanding why individuals adopt it has become a central concern for management and information-systems research. The dominant framework for this inquiry, the extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT2), is typically estimated using linear, variable-centred methods that report the average effect of each antecedent. A smaller but growing body of work instead applies fuzzy-set and configurational techniques, which treat adoption as arising from combinations of conditions rather than from independent drivers. This review synthesises that body of work. Following PRISMA 2020, we searched five databases and identified seventeen empirical studies that pair UTAUT2 with a fuzzy or configurational method across GenAI and adjacent technologies, appraising each with the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool. Three findings recur. First, performance expectancy and hedonic motivation are the most reliable predictors of adoption intention, whereas effort expectancy and social influence are markedly context-dependent. Second, facilitating conditions and habit relate more strongly to actual use than to intention, suggesting they operate at the stage where decisions become behaviour. Third, the configurational studies show that high adoption is achieved through several distinct and substitutable antecedent combinations rather than a single dominant path. Together, these results indicate that UTAUT2’s explanatory value is conditional on the analytical lens and context, and that fuzzy and configurational methods reveal equifinal, asymmetric adoption patterns that linear models leave hidden. We outline the implications for how GenAI adoption should be modelled

AI.tldr: 本文对结合UTAUT2与模糊集/组态方法研究GenAI采纳的17篇实证文献进行系统综述，发现：绩效期望和享乐动机是采纳意愿最稳定的预测因素，便利条件和习惯对实际使用的影响大于对意愿的影响，且高采纳可通过多种可替代的路径组合实现。
AI.research_question: 个体为何采纳生成式人工智能（GenAI）？哪些条件组合能够解释GenAI的采纳行为？
AI.motivation: GenAI已从新奇工具变为日常用品，但主流采纳研究多采用以变量为中心的线性方法（如UTAUT2），忽视了采纳条件的组合效应。作者旨在通过系统综述，整合模糊集与组态方法的研究成果，揭示线性模型无法捕捉的等效、非对称采纳模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的统一技术接受与使用理论（UTAUT2）；模糊集定性比较分析（fsQCA）等组态视角方法。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA 2020系统综述指南，检索五个数据库，筛选出17篇结合UTAUT2与模糊或组态方法的实证研究，并使用混合方法评价工具（MMAT）进行质量评估。
AI.findings: 1. 绩效期望和享乐动机是采纳意愿最可靠的预测因素，而努力期望和社交影响则高度依赖情境；2. 便利条件和习惯与实际使用的关系比与意愿的关系更强；3. 组态研究显示，高采纳可通过多种不同的、可相互替代的前因组合实现，而非单一主导路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了UTAUT2的解释价值依赖于分析视角和情境；证明了模糊集与组态方法能够发现线性模型隐藏的等效和非对称采纳模式；指出UTAUT2各构念在采纳意愿与实际使用阶段的作用存在差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和平台管理者提供了GenAI采纳的多路径策略设计依据；提示管理者应优先关注绩效提升和趣味性体验，并根据用户情境灵活调整努力期望和社交影响方面的推广策略。

title: World Models: A Survey
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: World Models: A Survey
detail.abstract:
In recent years, a family of machine learning models, the so-called world models, have been attracting growing attention. Particularly, now that large language models (LLMs) have been studied for at least a few years, one may thinker about what comes after large language models. Language models, as their name suggests, typically deal with language-based inputs, e.g., text inputs or other data modalities that can be expressed in some language(s). Such models are mostly trained on enormous amount of text data. As such, LLMs may not be generalized enough for comprehending complex environments, such as the physical world. 
Apparently, world models refer to a concept of more generalized machine learning models that can better comprehend their world (i.e., environment); and thus to abstract, reason and plan more like how intelligent creatures behave in the physical world. As world models are anticipated to be potential candidates for the next frontiers in artificial intelligence, in this article we provide a brief survey of models and neural constructions that are considered or are closely related to world models. We hope this article will be helpful for advancing the state-of-art research in world models.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了世界模型（world models）的概念、相关模型与神经结构，指出世界模型是比大型语言模型（LLMs）更通用的机器学习模型，能够更好地理解复杂环境（如物理世界），并像智能生物一样进行抽象、推理和规划，被认为是人工智能的下一个前沿方向。
AI.research_question: 世界模型是什么？它们与大型语言模型有何区别？当前有哪些模型和神经结构被认为属于或密切关联于世界模型？
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型主要处理基于语言的输入，训练于海量文本数据，可能不足以理解物理世界等复杂环境。因此，需要探索更通用的模型——世界模型，以推动人工智能迈向下一阶段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世界模型的概念；机器学习的通用化与环境理解；智能生物在物理世界中的抽象、推理与规划机制。
AI.method: 综述性研究，梳理和总结被认为属于或密切关联于世界模型的各类模型与神经结构。
AI.findings: 世界模型是比LLMs更通用的模型，能够更好地理解复杂环境；当前已有若干模型和神经结构被视为或接近于世界模型；世界模型有望成为人工智能的下一个前沿。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地界定了世界模型的概念及其与LLMs的区别；梳理了该领域的关键模型与神经结构，为后续研究提供了基础性参考框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了世界模型领域的现状概览，有助于推动相关研究的进展；指明了人工智能从语言模型向世界模型演进的方向。

title: Getting the Job Done: Using GenAI Embeddings to Uncover Customer Jobs in Commercial Banking
affiliations: , , affiliation not provided to SSRN, , and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Getting the Job Done: Using GenAI Embeddings to Uncover Customer Jobs in Commercial Banking
detail.abstract: Understanding what specific jobs customers are trying to get done has become a longstanding challenge in commercial banking. This paper shows how GenAI embeddings help banks address that problem by shifting the analytical frame from demographic segmentation toward a Jobs to Be Done (JTBD) perspective as understood in the disruptive innovation theory. Drawing on Danske Bank's SpotLight initiative, we demonstrate how embeddings compress complex behavioral data into a form that surfaces product relationships conventional methods tend to miss. Across experiments on anonymized customer observations, with datasets of up to 3,000 records, subject-matter experts validated the approach as a practically feasible way to identify customer behavior and the underlying jobs that drive it. What follows from that is a basis for strategies that attend to customer needs more fully than a product-by-product view allows.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了如何利用GenAI嵌入向量技术，将商业银行客户分析从传统的人口统计细分转向"待完成任务"（JTBD）视角，通过Danske银行的SpotLight项目验证了这一方法在实际业务中的可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用GenAI嵌入向量技术帮助商业银行识别客户试图完成的"具体任务"（Jobs to Be Done）？
AI.motivation: 商业银行长期以来面临理解客户具体需求的挑战，传统的人口统计细分方法难以揭示客户行为背后的深层动机和产品关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: disruptive innovation theory中的Jobs to Be Done（JTBD）视角
AI.method: 基于GenAI嵌入向量技术，对Danske银行SpotLight项目中的匿名客户观察数据（最多3,000条记录）进行实验分析，并由专家验证。
AI.findings: 嵌入向量能够将复杂的客户行为数据压缩成可揭示产品间关系的形式，这些关系是传统方法难以发现的；专家验证表明该方法在识别客户行为及驱动行为的潜在任务方面具有实际可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将JTBD理论与GenAI嵌入技术相结合，为商业银行客户分析提供了新的理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行提供了超越"逐产品分析"视角的客户需求识别方法，从而制定更全面满足客户需求的策略。

title: Could the Permian Basin Become Americaʼs Next AI Data Hub?

detail.title: Could the Permian Basin Become Americaʼs Next AI Data Hub?
detail.abstract: The existential AI race between the U.S. and China demands a massive, electricity-hungry digital industrial base. To avoid severe grid bottlenecks, America must urgently execute a private infrastructure boom on the scale of the historic Manhattan Project. The Permian Basin emerges as a premier solution, uniquely positioned to "build compute near the power". Rich in natural gas, wind, and solar resources, the Basin's surplus gas alone can fuel up to 25 gigawatts of hyperscale data center capacity. Despite water constraints, the Permian offers the unmatched physical space, fiber corridors, and skilled workforce vital to fully secure America’s global AI supremacy.

AI.tldr: 美国需以曼哈顿计划级别的私营基建在二叠纪盆地建设算力基础设施，利用当地天然气等能源解决AI竞赛中的电网瓶颈，确保对华AI优势。
AI.research_question: 在中美AI竞赛背景下，美国如何通过能源与基础设施布局解决电网瓶颈以维持AI领先地位？
AI.motivation: 中美之间的AI军备竞赛需要大量电力支撑数字工业基础，而美国现有电网面临严重瓶颈，亟需找到可行的能源与选址方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治竞争理论、能源-算力基础设施协同理论、大型项目（曼哈顿计划）类比框架。
AI.method: 案例分析（二叠纪盆地）、资源估算、比较分析（曼哈顿计划类比）。
AI.findings: 二叠纪盆地拥有丰富的天然气、风能、太阳能资源，仅天然气余量即可支持25吉瓦的超大规模数据中心；具备物理空间、光纤走廊和熟练劳动力优势，可解决电网瓶颈。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能源基础设施与AI算力竞争的理论结合，提出了"靠近能源建算力"这一新的地缘技术分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国政策制定者和产业界提供了二叠纪盆地作为AI算力中心的可行方案，指导优先基建投资方向。

title: Smart Simultaneous Governance: A Scalable Oversight Architecture for Article 57 AI Regulatory Sandboxes

detail.title: Smart Simultaneous Governance: A Scalable Oversight Architecture for Article 57 AI Regulatory Sandboxes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Human oversight of AI systems is resource-intensive, and this challenge becomes acute when National Competent Authorities must verify multiple concurrent AI systems in Article 57 regulatory sandboxes simultaneously. Notions of sandbox governance oversight lack a common operational foundation: verification methodologies are not clearly defined, roles of oversight personnel remain unclear, and approaches to assessing compliance at scale remain unresolved. This paper introduces Smart Simultaneous Governance, a four-layer verification architecture addressing this scalability gap. Layer 1 encodes relevant EU AI Act obligations as executable rules for automated structural checks, Layer 2 selects a risk-proportionate sample with a bounded re-sampling option protecting compliant systems from statistical noise while safeguarding consumer protection, Layer 3 brings independent domain specialists to judge whether sampled outputs cause real harm in practice, and Layer 4 detects demographic bias that individual review cannot see. We argue that AI governance should prioritise quality of oversight over quantity of assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能同步治理"四层验证架构，解决欧盟AI法案第57条监管沙盒中同时验证多个人工智能系统的资源瓶颈问题，通过自动化合规检查、风险比例抽样、领域专家评判和人口统计偏差检测，实现以监督质量替代评估数量的治理目标。
AI.research_question: 如何在资源有限的情况下，实现对监管沙盒中多个并发AI系统进行高效、高质量的同步验证？
AI.motivation: 现行AI监管中人工监督成本高昂，尤其是在国家主管机构需同时验证多个AI系统时，缺乏可操作性的验证方法论、监督人员角色定义不清、大规模合规评估方法未解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智能同步治理（Smart Simultaneous Governance）四层架构：第一层规则编码层、第二层风险比例抽样层、第三层领域专家评判层、第四层人口统计偏差检测层。
AI.method: 提出四层验证架构设计，包括：可执行规则自动化结构性检查、带边界重抽样选项的风险比例抽样、独立领域专家对实际危害的评判、以及个体审查无法识别的群体偏差检测。
AI.findings: 所提出的四层架构能够实现监督质量对评估数量的替代，通过自动化、风险比例化和专家化手段在有限资源下实现规模化合规验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出面向监管沙盒并发验证场景的"智能同步治理"概念与四层架构，为AI治理从"数量评估"转向"质量监督"提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟AI法案第57条监管沙盒中的国家主管机构提供了可落地的操作化验证方案，包括规则自动化、风险比例抽样、领域专家接入和偏差检测机制。

title: Agent-to-Agent Business Ecosystems: Delegated Commercial Agency, Governance, and a Reference Architecture for Autonomous Enterprise Commerce

detail.title: Agent-to-Agent Business Ecosystems: Delegated Commercial Agency, Governance, and a Reference Architecture for Autonomous Enterprise Commerce
detail.abstract: This study examines how interorganizational business ecosystems evolve when organizations transfer bounded commercial decision rights to human or computational organizational representatives that negotiate, commit, and coordinate across firm boundaries while principals retain residual accountability. The manuscript develops a mid-range theory of delegated commercial agency, in which governance capacity produces institutional commercial trust, institutional commercial trust enables the progressive transfer of a separable decision-rights bundle under risk-tiered autonomy, and increasing autonomy reconfigures coordination costs, firm boundaries, value capture, and ecosystem evolution under accountability tensions and competing transaction-cost paths. The theory explains how the joint configuration of governance as a market-enabling capability, unbundled rights redistribution, contingent rather than automatic market expansion, institutional commercial trust, and hybrid agent-centric ecosystem evolution can reshape interorganizational commerce without dissolving firm liability. A reference architecture for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Business Ecosystems operationalizes the proposed theory. Structured evidence synthesis motivates the underlying mechanisms, while constructs, a nomological network, boundary conditions, and propositions P1-P14 provide a testable theoretical framework. Fully autonomous cross-enterprise commerce at scale is not claimed as a present fact. The study contributes a business theory that conceptualizes autonomous enterprise agents as institutional economic actors operating under delegated commercial authority, extending the discussion of agent-to-agent commerce beyond technical architectures toward governance, institutional trust, and interorganizational business ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"委托商业代理"中观理论，研究企业如何将有限商业决策权转移给人类或计算代理人，构建代理对代理（A2A）商业生态系统，在保留企业责任的前提下重塑跨组织商业活动。
AI.research_question: 跨组织商业生态系统如何在组织将有限商业决策权转移给人类或计算代理（代理人谈判、承诺和协调，委托人保留最终责任）的过程中演化？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦技术架构层面的A2A交互，缺乏治理、制度信任和跨组织生态系统层面的商业理论。需要解释在保留企业责任的前提下，决策权转移如何影响生态系统演化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托商业代理中观理论：治理能力→制度商业信任→可分解决策权束的风险分层转移；治理作为市场赋能能力、权利再分配、条件性市场扩张、制度商业信任、混合代理中心生态系统演化等核心构念。
AI.method: 结构化证据综合（structured evidence synthesis）驱动机制推理；构建构念、nomological network、边界条件及P1-P14命题形成可检验理论框架；提出A2A商业生态参考架构。
AI.findings: 治理能力产生制度商业信任，信任推动可分解决策权束在风险分层自主权下渐进转移；自主权提升重构协调成本、企业边界、价值捕获及生态系统演化，受问责张力与竞争性交易成本路径制约。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自主企业代理人概念化为在委托商业权威下运作的制度经济行动者；将A2A商业讨论从技术架构扩展至治理、制度信任和跨组织商业生态系统领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在不解除法律责任的前提下，通过代理人实现跨组织商业自动化提供治理框架和参考架构；指导风险分层自主权的设计与实施。

title: Is Complexity Theory Right that Bigger Is Riskier? Evidence from Information Technology
affiliations: IT University of Copenhagen, IT University of Copenhagen, IT University of Copenhagen, University of Oxford - Said Business School and University of Oxford

detail.title: Is Complexity Theory Right that Bigger Is Riskier? Evidence from Information Technology
detail.abstract: A key thesis in complexity theory is that larger ventures entail higher risk. We test the thesis for information technology (IT) cost and schedule risk. We find that, contrary to common belief, project size is not a reliable predictor of risk. The common assumption that smaller projects have lower risk should be rejected based on our findings. In fact, the smallest IT projects have the largest risk. This finding is significant, because it challenges a central tenet of complexity theory, and it shows project management practitioners that small is not necessarily safe.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，IT项目中规模最小的项目反而风险最大，挑战了传统观点认为“大项目高风险、小项目低风险”的假设。
AI.research_question: 项目规模是否是IT项目成本和时间风险的可靠预测指标？
AI.motivation: 复杂性理论认为更大的企业/项目意味着更高的风险，但这一假设在IT项目风险领域中是否成立尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂性理论（complexity theory）——认为规模越大风险越高的核心论点。
AI.method: 实证研究，对IT项目的成本风险和时间进度风险进行统计检验。
AI.findings: 项目规模不是风险的可靠预测指标；最小的IT项目反而具有最大的风险；常见的“小项目风险低”的假设应被拒绝。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了复杂性理论的核心论点，即“规模越大风险越高”并非普遍成立，在IT项目情境中呈现相反模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒项目管理实践者：小项目并不一定安全，不能仅凭项目规模判断风险水平。

title: Smart Bond Contract: Disintermediating the Life Cycle of a Tokenized Security — Pilot Report
affiliations: DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG, Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Mathematics, DZ BANK AG, DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG, DZ Bank AG, KfW Bankengruppe, KfW Bankengruppe, KfW Bankengruppe, Cashlink, Deutsche Bundesbank, Jones Day, NTT Data Corporation and

detail.title: Smart Bond Contract: Disintermediating the Life Cycle of a Tokenized Security — Pilot Report

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are affiliated with organizations that participated in, advised on, or provided services or infrastructure for the pilot described in this report, as stated in the author affiliations and the report. The report was prepared in the course of the authors’ professional duties. The authors declare no other competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required. This report describes a technical and operational financial-market pilot involving institutional participants and did not involve human-subject research, patient data, or animal experiments.
declarations.funderStatement: The pilot and the preparation of this report were supported by the participating organizations identified in the report through staff time, infrastructure, and services provided in the ordinary course of their activities. No specific external research grant was received.

detail.abstract: In this note we document the Smart Bond Contract (SBC) pilot conducted by DZ BANK and KfW in March 2026. The pilot implemented the SBC protocol in a legally binding primarymarket transaction for a German crypto security (ISIN DE000SBC0DZ4) and demonstrated a complete deterministic lifecycle for a tokenized security on a public blockchain. The workflow covered on-chain publication of funding levels and digital transaction documentation, on-chain ISIN assignment, automated registration in a crypto securities register, token minting, decentralized Delivery-versus-Payment issuance, and final redemption settlement. Each step was executed by interconnected smart contracts on Polygon PoS without a central operator holding state or controlling the process. The transaction connected six market functions in direct peer-to-peer interaction: DZ BANK as issuer, KfW as investor, WM Datenservice as ISIN provider, Cashlink as crypto securities registrar, Deutsche Bundesbank as provider of the Trigger Solution for final cash settlement in central bank money in T2, and an NTT DATA-hosted decryption oracle. The pilot shows that the SBC concept can operate as an infrastructure-agnostic protocol rather than as a platform-specific workflow. By proving deterministic execution, modular process design, and intraday finality across issuance and redemption, the pilot provides practical evidence that tokenized securities lifecycle processes can be implemented transparently and without platform dependency.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了2026年3月DZ BANK与KfW进行的Smart Bond Contract（SBC）试点项目，在公共区块链Polygon PoS上实现了代币化证券的完整确定性生命周期，涵盖从发行到赎回的六个市场功能点对点交互，证明了SBC可作为基础设施无关的协议运行。
AI.research_question: 智能债券合约（SBC）协议能否在实际法律约束的一级市场交易中实现代币化证券的确定性、去中心化且基础设施无关的完整生命周期管理？
AI.motivation: 现有代币化证券方案多依赖特定平台或中心化运营方，缺乏透明性和可移植性。需要通过实际试点验证SBC协议是否能在公共区块链上以去中心化、无中央运营商的方式实现从发行到赎回的完整确定性流程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智能合约理论、代币化证券生命周期管理、去中心化交易结算机制（DvP）、区块链基础设施无关性协议设计
AI.method: 实地试点实验：2026年3月由DZ BANK和KfW在Polygon PoS公共区块链上执行SBC协议的一级市场交易，涉及六个市场参与者的点对点交互。
AI.findings: SBC协议成功实现了代币化证券的完整确定性生命周期，包括链上融资水平发布、ISIN分配、加密证券登记、代币铸造、去中心化DvP发行和赎回结算；所有步骤由互联智能合约执行，无需中央运营商；SBC可作为基础设施无关的协议而非平台特定工作流运行；实现了日内最终结算。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了SBC作为基础设施无关协议的证明概念，验证了代币化证券生命周期可通过确定性执行和模块化流程设计实现去平台依赖，为代币化证券的理论框架提供了新的协议层视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行和金融机构提供了去中心化债券发行的实际操作方案和实证证据；证明了公共区块链可用于合规的、法律约束的证券交易；展示了六个市场功能点对点交互的可行模式，为代币化证券的行业标准制定提供参考。

title: Constitutional Fidelity as Epistemic Governance: The Constitutional Integrity Monitor and the Prevention of Judicial Capture
affiliations: Liberty University

detail.title: Constitutional Fidelity as Epistemic Governance: The Constitutional Integrity Monitor and the Prevention of Judicial Capture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author developed the Emergency Powers Monitor (EPM) and Emergency Escalation Index (EEI) frameworks described in this manuscript as part of an ongoing research program examining epistemic governance, institutional accountability, and governance fidelity. The author may pursue future scholarly, educational, consulting, or software-related applications associated with these concepts. No external organization, government agency, political campaign, or commercial entity influenced the design, analysis, interpretation, or conclusions of this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects, identifiable personal data, clinical research, or animal subjects. Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was independently conceived, researched, and authored by the author.

detail.abstract: The Supreme Court of the United States confronts a crisis of legitimacy not because it decides wrongly, but because it decides opaquely. When constitutional interpretation shifts abruptly across decades—from Plessy to Brown, from Cruikshank to Heller—the public receives no empirical account of why the law changed beyond the assertion of judicial authority. This paper diagnoses this condition as epistemic capture: the gradual institutional loss of capacity to detect interpretive drift. Drawing on the Calibration Thesis, Faithful Intelligence governance principles, and design science methodology, the paper proposes a Constitutional Integrity Monitor (CIM)—an epistemic governance architecture that audits interpretive reasoning through statistical variance detection. The CIM does not decide cases; it measures the distance between proposed interpretations and the constitutional record through Analogical Gravity Mapping. Addressing the central vulnerability of algorithmic governance, the CIM integrates a formal contestation mechanism including a Weighting Review Board, an appeal protocol, and a minority dissent archive. The paper demonstrates through historical case analysis how the CIM would document interpretive evolution in landmark cases without endorsing any particular constitutional theory, and concludes that constitutional fidelity is served not by judicial mystique but by calibration transparency: the continuous alignment of interpretive authority with constitutional verification realities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出美国最高法院面临合法性危机的原因不是判决错误，而是判决不透明。作者诊断此问题为"认知俘获"（epistemic capture），并基于校准论、忠实情报治理原则和设计科学方法论，提出"宪法诚信监测器"（CIM）——一种通过统计方差检测来审计解释推理的认知治理架构。CIM不决定案件，而是通过"类比引力映射"衡量解释与宪法记录之间的距离，并整合了加权审查委员会、上诉协议和少数异议档案等正式争议机制。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种认知治理架构，使宪法解释的变迁能够被经验性地记录和审计，从而解决最高法院因决策不透明而面临的合法性危机？
AI.motivation: 美国最高法院在不同历史时期（如从Plessy到Brown，从Cruikshank到Heller）的解释发生急剧转变，但公众无法获得关于法律为何改变的经验性解释，只能接受司法权威的断言。这种"认知俘获"——制度逐渐丧失检测解释漂移的能力——损害了司法合法性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 校准论（Calibration Thesis）、忠实情报治理原则（Faithful Intelligence governance）、设计科学方法论（design science methodology）、认知俘获理论（epistemic capture）
AI.method: 设计科学研究：提出宪法诚信监测器（CIM）架构；历史案例分析法：验证CIM如何在标志性案件中记录解释演变。
AI.findings: 宪法诚信监测器能够通过类比引力映射衡量解释距离、通过统计方差检测识别解释漂移，而不需要认可任何特定的宪法理论；宪法忠诚的实现不依赖司法神秘主义，而依赖校准透明度——即解释权威与宪法验证现实的持续对齐。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"认知俘获"概念以诊断司法制度层面的解释漂移问题；将校准论从信息科学引入宪法解释领域；提出"类比引力映射"作为测量解释距离的形式化方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可供制度实践的宪法诚信监测器架构设计，包括加权审查委员会、上诉协议和少数异议档案等具体机制，为最高法院提高决策透明度和合法性提供可操作路径。

title: Artificial Intelligence Adoption and Financial Performance: Empirical Evidence from Emerging Markets with a Focus on Bangladesh

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence Adoption and Financial Performance: Empirical Evidence from Emerging Markets with a Focus on Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between Artificial Intelligence (AI) adoption and firm-level financial performance in emerging markets, with a particular focus on Bangladesh. Using a balanced panel of 60 firms listed on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) over 2018-2024, complemented by macroeconomic indicators from the World Bank, the paper applies fixed-and random-effects panel regression alongside ensemble machine-learning models (Random Forest and Gradient Boosting) to evaluate the impact of AI adoption on Return on Assets (ROA), Return on Equity (ROE), and net profit margin. The findings indicate that AI adoption significantly enhances firm performance by improving operational efficiency, reducing costs, and enabling data-driven decisionmaking. Each one-standard-deviation increase in the AI Adoption Index is associated with a 1.46-percentage-point increase in ROA after controlling for firm size, leverage, and industry effects. Results are robust across model specifications and validated by machine-learning predictions achieving 82-88% out-of-sample accuracy. The paper contributes to the literature by integrating traditional financial econometrics with modern AI-driven analytics in the context of a developing economy and offers actionable policy implications for accelerating digital transformation.

AI.tldr: 基于孟加拉国60家上市公司2018-2024年面板数据，使用固定/随机效应面板回归与集成机器学习模型，发现AI采纳每提高一个标准差，ROA增加1.46个百分点，显著提升新兴市场企业财务绩效。
AI.research_question: 人工智能采纳与新兴市场企业财务绩效之间是否存在显著正向关系？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场（尤其是孟加拉国）中AI采纳对企业财务绩效的实证证据不足，现有研究多聚焦发达国家，缺乏对发展中经济体的系统量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 运营效率理论、成本削减理论、数据驱动决策理论，以及新兴市场数字化转型理论。
AI.method: 采用2018-2024年60家达卡证券交易所上市公司平衡面板数据，结合世界银行宏观经济指标，运用固定效应与随机效应面板回归，以及随机森林和梯度提升集成机器学习模型。
AI.findings: AI采纳指数每增加一个标准差，ROA提升1.46个百分点；机器学习模型实现了82-88%的样本外预测准确率；结果在多种模型设定下稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统金融计量经济学与现代AI驱动分析相结合，为新兴经济体的数字化转型提供了实证理论基础；验证了AI采纳通过运营效率、成本降低和数据驱动决策提升财务绩效的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场企业和政策制定者提供加速数字化转型的行动建议，量化了AI投资的财务回报，可作为企业投资决策和政府产业政策的参考依据。

title: The Role of Women in Nigeria's Informal and Cross-Border Trade: A Gender Analysis

detail.title: The Role of Women in Nigeria's Informal and Cross-Border Trade: A Gender Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare no competing financial or institutional interests. However, I disclose that as a Nigerian, I have personally witnessed and gathered firsthand accounts from women traders operating at Nigeria’s informal and cross-border trade markets, including observations at the Nigeria–Benin border. These personal experiences informed the qualitative dimensions of this paper. The views expressed are solely my own and do not represent any organization or institution.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. I conducted this study independently and received no financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit organization.

detail.abstract: Women play a central role in Nigeria's informal and cross-border trade sector, contributing significantly to household welfare, local economies, and regional commerce. Despite accounting for the majority of informal cross-border traders, their contributions remain largely invisible in formal economic statistics and trade policymaking. This paper examines the participation of women in Nigeria's informal and cross-border trade, focusing on their socioeconomic characteristics, economic contributions, and the challenges they face, including financial exclusion, inadequate infrastructure, harassment at border crossings, and the burden of unpaid care work. The paper further analyzes the impact of regional trade frameworks, particularly the ECOWAS Protocols and the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), on women traders and assesses the extent to which these initiatives address gender-specific barriers. It argues that trade liberalization alone is insufficient to improve women's economic opportunities without complementary policies that promote financial inclusion, security, infrastructure development, social protection, and gender-responsive governance. By highlighting both the vulnerabilities and resilience of women traders, the paper underscores the need for inclusive trade policies that recognize and support their contributions to sustainable economic development and regional integration in Nigeria and West Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了尼日利亚女性在非正式和跨境贸易中的参与、贡献及面临的挑战，指出贸易自由化本身不足以改善女性经济机会，需要配套政策支持。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚女性在非正式和跨境贸易中的社会经济特征、经济贡献及面临的挑战是什么？区域贸易框架（ECOWAS议定书和AfCFTA）在多大程度上解决了性别特定的障碍？
AI.motivation: 女性在尼日利亚非正式和跨境贸易中占主导地位，但其贡献在正式经济统计和贸易政策制定中几乎不可见，亟需系统性地揭示其现状与政策缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别与发展理论、贸易与性别分析框架、非正式经济理论、区域一体化理论
AI.method: 文献分析、政策评估、定性分析（基于现有数据和政策文本进行综合分析）
AI.findings: 女性贸易者面临金融排斥、基础设施不足、边境骚扰、无偿照料工作负担等多重障碍；区域贸易框架虽有一定进展，但未能充分解决性别特定障碍；仅靠贸易自由化无法改善女性经济机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了贸易自由化与性别公平之间的复杂关系，论证了仅靠市场开放难以实现包容性发展，丰富了非正式经济与性别研究的理论交叉。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚及西非地区制定包容性贸易政策提供了实证依据，建议在贸易自由化基础上配套金融包容、安全保障、基础设施、社会保护和性别响应治理等政策。

title: Are Union Co-op Labor Negotiations a Win-Win and for Whom?

detail.title: Are Union Co-op Labor Negotiations a Win-Win and for Whom?

declarations.ethicsApproval: University of Louisville IRB approval 23.0831 - "Are union co-op labor negotiations a win-win and for whom?"

detail.abstract: Are union co-op labor negotiations in the United States more similar to the interest-based win-win negotiation framework popularized by Getting to Yes than traditional labor negotiations? If they are, do co-op labor negotiations and resultant collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) address some of the grand challenges of this historical time? This article explores how union negotiations in worker-owned co-ops compare to more traditional labor negotiations. Interviews with participants in union co-op collective bargaining and a review of several union co-op collective bargaining agreements suggest that many union co-op labor negotiations are more similar to interest-based negotiations than traditional labor negotiations. Those involved described these negotiations as more transparent, involving greater exchange of information, and oriented more toward cooperative problem-solving than traditional negotiations. Some agreements reference interest-based negotiations and others cooperative principles. The structure of the union cooperative may facilitate interest-based negotiations because of the greater sharing of information, including financial information, than in traditional negotiations and the orientation toward cooperative principles. Resultant advantages may include: 1) higher satisfaction from participants with the process and outcomes, and 2) workers gaining financial literacy and practicing problem-solving skills transferable to other settings.  The second part of this paper  provides background about the operations of more traditional labor negotiations in the United States and about the limited instances and business frameworks where collective bargaining and employee ownership intersect. The third part of the paper briefly describes union co-op labor negotiations to familiarize the reader with negotiation in this sector. In the fourth part, the paper expounds the theoretical framework from which the union co-op labor negotiations will be explored – the dispute resolution theories of distributive versus interest-based bargaining. In the final part, the paper analyzes several union co-op negotiations and resultant CBAs and addresses the questions posed at the outset of the research and this paper.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国工会-合作社集体谈判是否更接近《Getting to Yes》倡导的利益型谈判（而非传统劳资谈判），并分析这种模式是否有助于应对当代重大挑战。通过对谈判参与者的访谈和对集体谈判协议（CBAs）的审查发现，工会-合作社谈判更具透明度、信息共享更充分、更倾向于合作解决问题，并能提升参与者满意度和工人的财务素养。
AI.research_question: 美国工会-合作社的劳资谈判是否比传统劳资谈判更接近利益型（interest-based）双赢谈判框架？如果是，这种谈判及其产生的集体谈判协议（CBAs）是否有助于应对当代重大挑战？
AI.motivation: 探索工人所有制合作社中工会谈判与传统劳资谈判的差异，验证合作社结构是否天然有利于利益型谈判，并考察其对解决当代重大社会问题的潜在贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 争议解决理论中的分配型谈判（distributive bargaining）与利益型谈判（interest-based bargaining）对比框架，源自《Getting to Yes》的利益型谈判理论。
AI.method: 1) 对工会-合作社集体谈判参与者进行访谈；2) 审查多份工会-合作社集体谈判协议（CBAs）。
AI.findings: 工会-合作社谈判比传统谈判更透明、信息交换更充分、更偏向合作解决问题。部分协议明确引用利益型谈判或合作社原则。合作社结构因财务信息共享和合作原则导向，促进了利益型谈判的开展。优势包括：参与者对过程和结果满意度更高，工人获得财务知识并培养了可迁移的问题解决技能。
AI.theory_contributions: 将利益型谈判理论延伸到工人合作社这一特定组织情境，揭示了组织结构（信息共享、合作原则）如何影响谈判类型的选择和效果，丰富了争议解决理论在非传统劳资关系中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工会和合作社提供了谈判实践的改进方向：通过增强信息透明度和合作导向，可提升谈判满意度和工人技能发展；为政策制定者和组织设计者提供了合作社模式在改善劳资关系方面的实证依据。

title: A Quantitative Analysis of Security Breaches in the Digital Financial Sector and Organizational Commitment to People’s Security

detail.title: A Quantitative Analysis of Security Breaches in the Digital Financial Sector and Organizational Commitment to People’s Security
detail.abstract: This thesis explores how dedicating resources to people-focused security measures influences the likelihood of data breaches in the global financial industry. Although previous studies have connected broad cybersecurity practices to breach rates, few have zoomed in on investments in human capital as a riskmitigation strategy for banks, financial technology firms (fintechs), and other financial institutions. To fill this gap, we conducted a cross‐sectional quantitative survey of 50 security practitioners engaged via LinkedIn that reached seasoned security professionals across multiple countries. We then categorized responses on employee training, awareness campaigns, and dedicated security budgets. This thesis observes patterns linking these investments to actual security breach events. This thesis hypothesizes that firms allocating more to workforce security will report fewer incidents, though we expect factors like company size and regional regulation to modulate this effect. Our findings aim both to enrich academic discussions around the “people” dimension of cybersecurity and to offer practical guidance on crafting cost-effective, human-centered defenses. Future work might compare these results across other sectors or track changes over time to build on our initial insights.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对50名金融行业安全从业者的问卷调查，探讨了在人员安全措施上的投入如何影响数据泄露事件的发生概率，发现人力资本投资与安全事件之间存在关联模式。
AI.research_question: 在金融行业中，将资源投入以人为中心的安全措施会如何影响数据泄露事件的发生概率？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注广义的网络安全实践与泄露率的关系，但很少聚焦于人力资本投资（如员工培训、安全意识活动、安全预算）作为风险缓解策略的具体效果，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络安全人力资本投资理论、风险缓解理论
AI.method: 横截面定量调查，通过LinkedIn招募50名来自多国的金融行业安全从业者，对员工培训、安全意识活动和专用安全预算等变量进行分类分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现人员安全投入与实际安全泄露事件之间存在关联模式；投入更多人力安全资源的机构报告更少的事件，但公司规模和地区监管等因素会调节这一效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于网络安全中"人"这一维度的学术讨论，将研究焦点从技术防御拓展到人力资本投资层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了关于如何构建成本效益高、以人为核心的安全防御体系的实践指导。

title: The Dual Experiential Spiral: A Framework for Faculty-Student AI Literacy Co-Development in Higher Education
affiliations: and University of Pittsburgh - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Dual Experiential Spiral: A Framework for Faculty-Student AI Literacy Co-Development in Higher Education
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Dual Experiential Spiral (DES), a theoretical framework for understanding AI literacy in higher education as a co-developmental faculty-student process rather than two parallel institutional problems. Faculty AI literacy and student AI literacy are typically addressed through separate professional development tracks and student-facing programs. We argue this siloed approach is theoretically incomplete because the two are coupled processes whose interaction may substantially shape the development of both. Drawing on Kolb's (1984) experiential learning spiral, Vygotsky's (1978) Zone of Proximal Development, and Davis's (1989) Technology Acceptance Model, DES proposes that two interdependent learning spiralsone for faculty and one for students-become coupled through structured AI engagement in the shared classroom. We advance three testable propositions: (1) both populations develop AI literacy through upward experiential spirals; (2) structured classroom AI engagement couples these spirals through bidirectional feedback; and (3) coupling requires three enabling conditions: structured contact, bidirectional feedback flow, and mutual psychological safety. We also specify boundary conditions under which coupling may fail, including institutional reward structures that reinforce one-way delivery, top-down mandates without participation, and student compliance without authentic engagement. Implications are drawn for course design, institutional investment, educational equity, and research methodology in higher education systems globally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"双体验螺旋"（DES）理论框架，将高校师生AI素养视为相互耦合的共同发展过程，而非两个独立的平行问题。该框架整合了Kolb的经验学习螺旋、Vygotsky的最近发展区理论和Davis的技术接受模型，提出三个可检验命题及三个耦合条件，并指出制度性障碍可能导致耦合失败。
AI.research_question: 高校教师和学生的人工智能素养如何作为相互耦合的共同发展过程来理解与培养？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将教师AI素养和学生AI素养视为两个独立的制度问题，分别通过教师专业发展和学生项目来应对。这种"各自为政"的方式在理论上是片面的，因为它忽视了两者之间的交互耦合关系，而这一关系可能深刻影响双方的素养发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: (1) Kolb(1984)经验学习螺旋——解释AI素养通过具体体验、反思观察、抽象概念化和主动实验的循环上升；(2) Vygotsky(1978)最近发展区——解释师生互动中相互脚手架的作用；(3) Davis(1989)技术接受模型——解释师生对AI技术的感知有用性和感知易用性如何影响采纳行为。三者整合形成"双体验螺旋"框架。
AI.method: 理论建构与命题推导。通过整合三大经典理论，提出三个可检验的命题，并明确耦合条件与边界条件。
AI.findings: (1) 师生分别通过向上的经验螺旋发展AI素养；(2) 结构化的课堂AI参与通过双向反馈将两个螺旋耦合；(3) 耦合需要三个条件：结构化接触、双向反馈流、相互心理安全感。边界条件包括：制度奖励结构强化单向传递、自上而下的强制命令缺乏参与、学生仅顺从而无真实投入。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"耦合发展"视角，打破AI素养研究中教师端与学生端割裂的理论范式；将经验学习理论、社会文化理论和技术接受模型整合为统一框架，为AI素养的互动本质提供了新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校课程设计提供指导（如结构化课堂AI互动设计）；为机构投资提供方向（如创造耦合条件而非孤立投入）；促进教育公平（避免仅惠及部分群体的AI素养发展）；为全球高等教育系统提供方法论建议。

title: Capital Cliffs and EU Securitisation Regulations
affiliations: Society of Actuaries, Risk Control Limited, affiliation not provided to SSRN, EBA and Risk Control Limited

detail.title: Capital Cliffs and EU Securitisation Regulations
detail.abstract: This report assesses cliff effects in European securitisation capital rules. Capital cliffs create distortions and exacerbate instability in financial stress periods. Regulators work to remove such cliffs when memories of financial crises are fresh. But cliffs may creep back as the authorities fine-tune earlier decisions and recollection of stress conditions fades. Right now, European regulators, aware of the region's investment needs, are considering adjustments aimed at reviving the securitisation market. This study argues that those designing the new rules should take steps to identify and remove cliff effects from the framework.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了欧洲证券化资本规则中的断崖效应，指出资本断崖会造成扭曲并在金融压力期加剧不稳定性。研究认为，监管者在金融危机记忆犹新时会努力消除断崖，但随着时间推移和记忆淡化，断崖可能重新出现。当前欧洲监管者正考虑调整规则以振兴证券化市场，本文主张新规则设计应采取步骤识别并消除框架中的断崖效应。
AI.research_question: 欧洲证券化资本规则中存在哪些断崖效应？这些效应如何影响金融稳定性？如何在规则调整中有效识别并消除这些断崖效应？
AI.motivation: 欧洲监管者正考虑调整证券化资本规则以振兴市场，但历史经验表明，规则调整可能导致断崖效应重新出现，从而在金融压力期加剧不稳定性。本研究旨在提醒规则制定者关注这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本监管的断崖效应理论：资本规则中的非连续性（断崖）会造成市场扭曲，并在金融压力期放大不稳定性；监管记忆衰减理论：随着金融危机记忆的淡化，监管者可能重新引入或忽视断崖效应。
AI.method: 政策分析与评估研究，基于对欧洲证券化资本规则的制度分析与历史回顾。
AI.findings: 欧洲证券化资本规则中存在断崖效应；这些断崖效应在金融压力期会加剧市场不稳定性；监管者对断崖的警惕会随时间推移和危机记忆淡化而减弱；当前欧洲规则调整过程中存在断崖效应重新出现的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将断崖效应理论应用于欧洲证券化资本监管领域，揭示了监管记忆衰减与断崖效应复现之间的动态关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲监管者在调整证券化资本规则时提供政策建议：应采取系统性的步骤识别并消除规则框架中的断崖效应，以避免金融不稳定风险的上升。

title: Guarantee Companies & Development Finance: Products, Business Models & Constraints
affiliations: Risk Control Limited

detail.title: Guarantee Companies & Development Finance: Products, Business Models & Constraints
detail.abstract:
Specialist guarantee companies can play a valuable role in financial markets when other intermediaries such as banks or bond market investors are unable or unwilling to take on specific risks. 

An example is the guarantees that monoline insurers provided for infrastructure debt in the 1990s and early 2000s. In those years, several developed-economy governments wished to raise funding for public investment without encumbering their balance sheets. Corporates also sought financing for investment purposes either through their own on-balance-sheet debt issues or via bankruptcy remote Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs). Saving institutions like pension funds lacked the infrastructure teams necessary to evaluate the complex risks involved. The solution was that monoline insurers provided guarantees, raising the ratings of bond issues. They acted as controlling creditors, monitoring project conditions and covenants on behalf of all creditors. 

The monoline insurers just described had emerged earlier in the United States (US) municipal bond market. In that context, tax considerations provided incentives that fragmented the market, motivating retail investors to invest in non-diversified ways in opaque bond issues. Again, the monolines provided a solution by supplying 100% wraps on municipal bond issues. These wraps mitigated the effects of informational asymmetry and a taxinduced lack of diversification. 

This study examines the experience of monoline insurers to see whether one may draw lessons for the use of specialist guarantee companies in Emerging Market and Developing Economy (EMDE) countries. Donor countries and Development Banks (multilateral and bilateral) have invested in specialist guarantee companies. We review the activities of these EMDE guarantee companies, commenting on constraints and the potential they offer to drive development financing. 

The report aims to inform donor-country decision makers considering whether to invest in specialist guarantee companies. We believe that in reviewing the experience of the monolines and studying EMDE guarantee companies, the study may be of interest also to operators of guarantee companies and even for institutional investors. 

Our analysis draws on interviews with more than forty industry practitioners including past and current staff of developed-market monolines, Development Finance Institutions (DFIs) and specialist EMDE guarantee funds. We analyse the financial statements and ratings of a prominent developed market monoline and two EMDE guarantee funds to understand the constraints they face, most notably the assessments they receive from rating agencies and the profitability of their business models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了单一险种担保公司（monoline insurers）在发达市场中的作用，并探讨其经验对新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDE）专业担保公司的借鉴意义。通过对从业者访谈和财务报表分析，文章评估了EMDE担保公司在促进发展融资中的潜力与约束。
AI.research_question: 发达市场单一险种担保公司的经验如何为新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDE）的专业担保公司提供借鉴，以推动发展融资？
AI.motivation: 当银行或债券市场投资者无法或不愿承担特定风险时，专业担保公司可发挥重要作用。捐赠国和开发银行已投资于EMDE担保公司，但对其运作约束和潜力缺乏系统分析，需要基于发达市场经验进行审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、信用增级机制、市场分割理论（税收激励导致的非分散化投资）
AI.method: 对40多位行业从业者（包括发达市场单一险种公司、开发金融机构和EMDE担保基金人员）进行访谈；分析发达市场单一险种公司和两家EMDE担保基金的财务报表与评级。
AI.findings: 单一险种担保公司通过提供信用增级（如100%担保）缓解信息不对称和税收导致的市场分割问题；EMDE担保公司在评级约束和业务模式盈利性方面面临挑战，但具有推动发展融资的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将单一险种担保机制从发达市政债市场扩展到基础设施融资和发展融资领域，揭示了专业担保公司作为控制债权人（controlling creditor）在降低信息不对称中的制度化作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为捐赠国决策者投资EMDE专业担保公司提供经验证据和约束分析；为担保公司运营者和机构投资者提供实践参考。

title: Stripping Discount Curves Across Currencies: Transfer Learning from US Treasuries
affiliations: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), Stanford University - Department of Management Science & Engineering and Stanford

detail.title: Stripping Discount Curves Across Currencies: Transfer Learning from US Treasuries
detail.abstract: We provide precise international yield curves that constitute the new reference database for the government bond markets of six major economies, estimated with a robust and flexible machine learning method regularized by economic principles. We first show that the kernel ridge regression (KR) method of Filipovic, Pelger, and Ye (2024), the most precise method for US Treasuries, generalizes to all international bond markets and uniformly dominates the Nelson-Siegel-Svensson (NSS) benchmark used by many central banks. When foreign exchange (FX) markets provide additional information, we further improve upon KR with a novel transfer learning extension, KR-Transfer (KR-T). KR-T converts US Treasuries into target-currency "synthetic bonds" using FX spot and forward rates and estimates the discount curves jointly under a weak covered interest parity (CIP) condition, which penalizes only the curvature of the cross-currency spread and leaves its level and slope unconstrained. Under block cross-validation that mimics real-world maturity gaps, KR-T reduces out-of-sample yield errors by up to 44% relative to KR and by 68-87% relative to NSS, while matching KR where local data are sufficient. The gains concentrate at maturities where FX forwards are observed, identifying FX forward availability as the economic channel of transfer learning. KR-T also delivers more stable forward rates and more plausible yield curve dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套精确的国际收益率曲线参考数据库，使用基于经济原则正则化的机器学习方法（核岭回归及迁移学习扩展KR-T）进行估计，在六个主要经济体的政府债券市场中显著优于传统NSS基准模型，尤其在利用外汇远期信息时，收益率预测误差最多可降低87%。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法和外汇市场信息，构建比央行现行标准（Nelson-Siegel-Svensson模型）更精确、更稳健的国际政府债券收益率曲线？
AI.motivation: 现有国际收益率曲线数据库多采用NSS模型，精确度有限；而最新的核岭回归方法虽对美债表现出色，但尚未验证其在国际市场的通用性，且未利用外汇市场提供的跨市场信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核岭回归（KR）；迁移学习；覆盖利率平价（CIP）条件；跨货币利差曲率惩罚。
AI.method: 提出KR-Transfer（KR-T）方法，利用外汇即期和远期汇率将美国国债转换为目标货币的"合成债券"，在弱CIP条件下联合估计贴现曲线，仅约束跨货币利差的曲率，不约束其水平和斜率。采用块交叉验证进行样本外评估。
AI.findings: KR在国际债券市场上一致优于NSS；KR-T进一步将收益率预测误差相对于KR降低最多44%，相对于NSS降低68-87%；增益集中于外汇远期可观测的期限；KR-T提供更稳定的远期利率和更合理的收益率曲线动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将KR方法从美债推广至国际债券市场，证明了其通用性；提出了结合外汇信息的迁移学习方法，在保留KR精度的同时通过弱CIP约束实现跨市场信息传导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为六大经济体提供了新的精确收益率曲线参考数据库，可替代央行现行NSS标准；为资产管理、风险管理和货币政策分析提供了更可靠的利率期限结构估计。

reference: 41 Ohio St. J. on Disp. Resol. 1 (2026)
title: Rightsizing Arbitration

detail.title: Rightsizing Arbitration

publicationDetails.detailsText: 41 Ohio St. J. on Disp. Resol. 1 (2026)

detail.abstract: Assuming the Federal Arbitration Act (FAA), our country, and its democratic ideals survive 100 more years, several scenarios for its application to employment arbitration and to labor arbitration may play out. As to employment arbitration, legislators will continue to push to limit its scope, and courts will continue to develop the FAA jurisprudence in the employment area in ways that address the relatively unequal bargaining position of workers and the entities for which they labor. As to labor arbitration, courts will continue to intermittently apply the FAA without clarity as to whether it applies or is merely persuasive authority. Legislators may or may not overlook labor arbitration as they promulgate amendments and supplemental legislation to the FAA. Despite the quagmire of uncertainty about the FAA’s role in labor arbitration, development by the courts of the precise test to determine when an arbitrator exceeds their authority will continue. The system of labor arbitration and its protection of the right to strike, will be enhanced to the extent courts reconfirm that an arbitrator exceeds their authority only when they fail to interpret the collective bargaining agreement. This article first provides background for those unfamiliar with employment arbitration and labor arbitration. Second, the article explains why the use of pre-dispute arbitration of statutory employment claims is problematic and why federal legislation may or may not address this problem over the next 100 years. Third, it describes the conflict in the courts over the test for when a labor arbitrator exceeds their authority and explains the impact on collective bargaining of which interpretation prevails over the next 100 years.

AI.tldr: 本文展望未来100年《联邦仲裁法》（FAA）在就业仲裁和劳动仲裁中的演变，重点讨论了立法与司法在调整仲裁适用范围、保障工人议价能力以及明确仲裁员越权标准方面的可能走向。
AI.research_question: 在未来100年内，《联邦仲裁法》在就业仲裁和劳动仲裁领域将如何演变？特别是立法与司法将如何应对工人议价能力不对等问题，以及仲裁员越权标准将如何发展？
AI.motivation: 当前FAA在就业仲裁和劳动仲裁领域存在大量不确定性，包括是否适用于劳动仲裁、如何解决就业仲裁中工人议价能力不对等问题，以及仲裁员越权的判定标准不统一，亟需前瞻性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦仲裁法（FAA）的法律解释框架；集体谈判协议（CBA）的合同解释理论；仲裁员权限的司法审查标准。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合对未来立法趋势和司法判例发展的预测性推理。
AI.findings: 1）就业仲裁方面，立法将持续限制其适用范围，法院将发展FAA判例以应对劳资双方议价能力不平等；2）劳动仲裁方面，法院仍将间歇性适用FAA，但对其是否直接适用或仅为说服性权威缺乏明确性；3）仲裁员越权标准将朝更严格方向演进——仅当仲裁员未能解释集体谈判协议时才构成越权，这将增强劳动仲裁体系并保护罢工权。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了FAA在未来100年可能的发展路径，提出"仲裁员越权"的精准测试标准（仅以是否解释集体谈判协议为限），为劳动仲裁理论提供了更清晰的司法审查边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了立法修改方向（限制就业仲裁范围、明确劳动仲裁是否适用FAA）；为法院提供了仲裁员越权判定标准；为劳资双方提供了仲裁制度未来演变的预期指引。

title: One Axis, Two Observations: Restating the Relation between Value and Price

detail.title: One Axis, Two Observations: Restating the Relation between Value and Price
detail.abstract: In the explanation of price, value is redundant: given a system's technical and distributive conditions, prices are fully determined without appeal to value (Sraffa, 1960; Steedman, 1977). Yet value has never withdrawn; it remains in use even after being shown redundant. This paper resolves that paradox of the "redundant but indispensable." The key is to see that value and price are not two entities but two observations of a single axis — worth, the plain question "how much is this worth." Which observation one takes is fixed by function: in expressing one's own demand and closing a transaction, one looks at worth from the angle of price; in holding, for the sake of decision, a judgment aimed at the public level, one looks at worth from the angle of value. Both observe the same axis, and so do not split it but jointly reflect it. At the public level, worth has a ready objective answer — the de-biased moving centre of countless transactions, which exists yet cannot be reached exactly. A boundedly rational subject cannot reach it, and so, from local samples, estimates a reachable proxy: this is value, a cognitive proxy that compresses a diffuse price-regularity into a usable judgment. Value and price share one source and do not determine each other; the supposed "circularity of value and price" is merely the result of mistaking two observations of one axis for two entities and letting them determine each other — once the premise is exposed, it dissolves on its own. This paper is an explanatory framework. It does not claim to have explained reality, but every part of it is built to aim at reality; its legitimacy rests on parsimony, unification, and falsifiability, and it offers refutable logical prohibitions together with one directional prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出价值与价格并非两个独立实体，而是对同一轴心"worth"的两种观测视角：价格用于交易表达自身需求，价值用于公共层面的决策判断。价值是有限理性主体对价格规律的认知代理，二者同源而非互决，从而解构了"价值冗余但不可或缺"的悖论。
AI.research_question: 价值在理论上已被证明是冗余的（Sraffa, 1960; Steedman, 1977），却始终未被抛弃。这一"冗余但不可或缺"的悖论如何解释？
AI.motivation: 古典劳动价值论之后，新李嘉图学派（斯拉法、斯蒂德曼）证明无需价值即可确定价格，但价值概念仍在经济学话语中持续存在。这一理论与现实的张力亟需一个统一的理论框架加以解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出"worth"（价值轴）作为统一本体：价格是交易者在表达自身需求、完成交易时对worth的观测视角；价值是决策者在公共层面进行判断时对worth的观测视角。价值是有限理性主体对分散价格规律进行压缩的认知代理（cognitive proxy）。
AI.method: 概念分析与逻辑推演的理论框架构建。作者未采用实证方法，而是提出一个"解释性框架"（explanatory framework），其合法性依据简洁性、统一性与可证伪性。
AI.findings: 价值与价格同源而不互决。"价值与价格的循环论证"源于将同一轴心的两种观测误认为两个独立实体并让其相互决定。一旦澄清本体论前提，该循环自行消解。价值是有限理性主体对无法精确到达的"去偏移动中心"（de-biased moving centre）的局部估计代理。
AI.theory_contributions: 将价值与价格从"实体对立"框架中解放，重构为"同一轴心的不同观测函数"；将价值重新定义为认知代理而非独立实体，弥合了古典价值理论与新古典价格理论之间的长期裂痕；消解了斯拉法时代以来的"价值冗余"悖论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学方法论提供了新的概念基础：价值不再需要被"还原"为价格或被视为多余，而是有其独立的认知功能——在公共决策层面提供可用的判断代理。这影响了经济评估、公共政策分析中对价值与价格的使用方式。

title: Comparative Evaluation of Portfolio Management Paradigms

detail.title: Comparative Evaluation of Portfolio Management Paradigms
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates three portfolio-management paradigms over an approximately five-year public-evidence horizon: automated robo-advisory platforms, emerging AI and machine-learning portfolio systems, and trained human managers or standard benchmark portfolios. The analysis uses risk-adjusted performance measures, observable fee schedules, official ETF and platform disclosures, academic research, and industry scorecards. Current evidence suggests that robo-advisors provide the clearest low-cost implementation case for retail investors, primarily through diversified beta exposure, automatic rebalancing, and disciplined portfolio maintenance. AI and machine-learning methods show meaningful research potential, including strong out-ofsample results in selected academic settings, but live publicly investable AI-labeled products do not yet establish broad superiority after fees, turnover, and implementation costs. Active human managers continue to face a difficult benchmark-relative performance hurdle, particularly in U.S. large-cap equities, while human advisors retain a defensible role in behavioral coaching, tax-aware planning, estate coordination, and judgment-heavy client decisions. The most plausible next-stage model is therefore not pure robo-advice, pure AI, or pure human active management, but a human-in-the-loop architecture combining automated core portfolios, AI-assisted analytics, and human oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三种投资组合管理范式——机器人投顾、AI/机器学习系统、人工管理者——经过约五年的公开证据分析，发现机器人投顾最适合零售投资者，AI方法有研究潜力但尚未在公开产品中证明广泛优越性，人工管理面临业绩挑战但保留行为指导等价值，未来最可能的是人机协同模式。
AI.research_question: 在约五年的公开证据期内，三种投资组合管理范式（机器人投顾、AI/机器学习系统、人工管理者或标准基准组合）在风险调整后表现、成本效益和实际可行性方面孰优孰劣？
AI.motivation: 随着金融科技的发展，机器人投顾和AI投资系统日益兴起，但缺乏对这三种范式在公开可验证的长期时间窗口内的系统性比较评估，投资者和行业从业者需要基于实证证据的决策参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代投资组合理论（MPT）、风险调整后的绩效评估框架、行为金融学（行为指导与偏差纠正）、人机交互决策架构（human-in-the-loop）
AI.method: 采用多源公开证据的综合分析方法，包括风险调整绩效指标、费用表、ETF和平台官方披露文件、学术研究文献以及行业评分卡数据，对三种范式进行横向比较评估。
AI.findings: 1. 机器人投顾为零售投资者提供了最清晰的低成本实施路径，主要通过多元化贝塔暴露、自动再平衡和纪律性组合维护实现优势；2. AI/ML方法在学术环境中展示了强劲的样本外结果和研究潜力，但公开可投资的AI标签产品在扣除费用、换手成本和实施成本后尚未建立广泛的优越性；3. 主动型人工管理者在美股大盘股中持续面临基准相对表现的困难，但人工顾问在行为指导、税务规划、遗产协调和需要判断力的客户决策中保留着可防御的角色。
AI.theory_contributions: 为三种投资管理范式提供了约五年窗口期的系统比较证据，提出了"人机协同架构"（human-in-the-loop）作为未来投资管理模式的理论方向，整合了自动化核心组合、AI辅助分析和人类监督的三层结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售投资者提供了选择投资管理模式的实证依据（推荐机器人投顾作为低成本方案），为行业指明了未来发展方向——纯机器人、纯AI或纯人工管理都不太可能是最优解，人机协同才是可行路径。

title: Rural Dengue Dynamics: The Interplay of Climate, Built Environment, and Agriculture in Costa Rica
affiliations: Stanford University, Stanford University, Stanford University, University of Costa Rica, University of Costa Rica, University of Costa Rica, , Costa Rica Ministry of Health and Stanford University

detail.title: Rural Dengue Dynamics: The Interplay of Climate, Built Environment, and Agriculture in Costa Rica
detail.abstract: Dengue is one of the world’s highest-burden arboviral diseases. Although classically considered an urban disease, many regions experience a substantial dengue burden in rural areas. The combined influence of long-term climate, short-term weather variation, local built environments, and land-use gradients on dengue dynamics in rural settings remains poorly understood, limiting our ability to predict shifting risk under global change. Here, we investigate these dynamics in Costa Rica to disentangle how these interacting socio-environmental factors shape rural dengue transmission. We first use 22 years of canton-level (admin-2) case data to establish that both dengue cases and incidence are consistently higher in rural than in urban districts. Then, using ten years of district-level (admin-3) monthly case data and a Bayesian hierarchical modeling framework, we identify the climatic and land-use features most strongly associated with dengue risk. Temperature underlies broad spatial patterns in dengue’s urban–rural distribution, while precipitation effects differ between coasts, reflecting intercoastal climate zone contrasts rather than interactions between urbanization and water availability. Given suitable climate, even modest levels of built infrastructure substantially increase risk, but the relationship plateaus at higher levels of building volume. Dengue risk is also elevated in areas with high agricultural crop cover at low and mid elevations but not at higher, cooler elevations. Together these results suggest that high risk of rural dengue in Costa Rica result from climate suitability aligning with baseline levels of built infrastructure, with agriculture potentially emerging as a distinct driver of rural dengue transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文利用哥斯达黎加22年的病例数据，揭示了农村地区登革热风险高于城市，气候适宜性与基础建成环境是主要驱动因素，农业在中低海拔地区也显著增加风险。
AI.research_question: 在乡村环境中，长期气候、短期天气变化、建成环境及土地利用梯度如何共同影响登革热传播动态？
AI.motivation: 登革热通常被视为城市疾病，但许多农村地区疾病负担也很高。农村环境下多因素（气候、建成环境、土地利用）的交互影响尚不清楚，限制了全球变化下的风险预测能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯层次建模、气候-土地利用-建成环境交互框架、城市-农村梯度分析
AI.method: 首先用22年区级（admin-2）病例数据比较城乡差别，再用10年地区级（admin-3）月度病例数据，结合贝叶斯层次模型分析气候与土地利用特征。
AI.findings: 1）哥斯达黎加农村地区的登革热病例和发病率均持续高于城市；2）温度主导登革热城乡分布的空间格局，降水效应因海岸气候区不同而异；3）在气候适宜条件下，低水平建成基础设施即显著增加风险，但随建筑体积增加风险趋于平缓；4）中低海拔农业用地覆盖率高的地区风险增加，高海拔凉爽地区无此效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了农村登革热高风险的核心机制：气候适宜性与基础建成环境的耦合，并识别出农业作为农村登革热传播的独特驱动因素，挑战了登革热纯粹是"城市病"的传统认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球变化下农村登革热风险预测和防控提供依据，提示农村地区应关注气候适宜区的基础设施建设和农业活动带来的额外风险。

title: From Data Protection to Fundamental Rights: Why FRIA Represents a Significant Step Toward a Paradigm Shift in the EU AI Act
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: From Data Protection to Fundamental Rights: Why FRIA Represents a Significant Step Toward a Paradigm Shift in the EU AI Act

declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author declares no financial support for the research, authorship, or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: For more than a decade, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) has served as the dominant paradigm for thinking about digital rights, both within the European Union and beyond. This paper employs a comparative analysis of the GDPR and the EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act), focusing on Article 27 of the latter, to demonstrate that the Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (FRIA) is not merely an extension or an upgraded version of the Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA). The paper's central finding is that FRIA marks a significant, and still contested, step toward a paradigm shift from data protection to fundamental rights protection, even though many regulators and practitioners currently continue to treat it, in practice, as an extension of existing data protection assessment processes. The philosophical roots of this shift lie in the principle of human dignity as enshrined in Article 1 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union. Beyond the conceptual claim, the paper also examines the economic burden that FRIA-style obligations impose, particularly on small and medium-sized enterprises and under-resourced public bodies, and situates the EU's recent decision to delay implementation within that administrative-cost context. The paper concludes that any legal system, including Iran's, currently drafting or reconsidering a governance framework for artificial intelligence, should not reduce the matter to personal data protection alone, but must instead provide independent mechanisms for fundamental rights impact assessment, algorithmic transparency, human oversight, the right to contest automated decisions, and accountability, while building proportionality to institutional capacity into the design from the outset.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较GDPR与欧盟《人工智能法案》（AI Act）第27条，论证基本权利影响评估（FRIA）并非数据保护影响评估（DPIA）的简单升级，而是标志着从数据保护向基本权利保护的范式转变。这一转变的哲学基础源于《欧盟基本权利宪章》第1条的人类尊严原则。文章还分析了FRIA对中小企业和资源不足公共机构的经济负担，指出欧盟延迟实施的决策与行政成本相关。最后，文章建议包括伊朗在内的任何正在起草AI治理框架的法律体系，不应将问题简化为个人数据保护，而应提供独立的基本权利影响评估机制，并从一开始就将比例原则纳入制度设计。
AI.research_question: GDPR框架下的数据保护影响评估（DPIA）与AI Act中的基本权利影响评估（FRIA）之间存在何种本质差异？FRIA是否构成从数据保护到基本权利保护的范式转变？
AI.motivation: 现有实践和监管中，许多人将FRIA视为DPIA的简单延伸，但作者认为这种理解忽视了二者在理论基础和保护对象上的根本差异。澄清这一区别对于正确理解和实施AI治理框架至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以《欧盟基本权利宪章》第1条的人类尊严原则为哲学基础，区分"数据保护"与"基本权利保护"两个不同的法律范式，论证FRIA代表前者向后者的范式转换。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对GDPR与AI Act（特别是第27条）进行系统比较，结合对实施成本和监管延迟的实证考察。
AI.findings: （1）FRIA不是DPIA的简单升级，而是范式转变；（2）转变的哲学根基是人类尊严原则；（3）FRIA对中小企业和公共机构造成显著经济负担；（4）欧盟延迟实施决策与行政成本考量相关；（5）任何AI治理框架都应建立独立的FRIA机制，而非仅关注数据保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了FRIA与DPIA之间的本质区别，揭示了从数据保护范式向基本权利保护范式的理论转变，并以人类尊严原则为这一转变提供了哲学论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出FRIA实施中的实际经济负担问题，为政策制定者（尤其是伊朗等正在构建AI治理框架的国家）提供了具体建议：不应局限于数据保护，而应建立独立的基本权利影响评估、算法透明度、人类监督、自动决策异议权和问责机制，并从一开始就纳入与制度能力相称的比例原则。

title: Educational Discontinuation and Early Union Formation Among Young Women in Cambodia: Evidence from the 2021–22 Demographic and Health Survey
affiliations: University of Puthisastra and University of Puthisastra

detail.title: Educational Discontinuation and Early Union Formation Among Young Women in Cambodia: Evidence from the 2021–22 Demographic and Health Survey

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Background: Early union formation (marriage or cohabitation before age 18) remains a significant public health concern in Cambodia, with wide-ranging implications for women's health, education, and economic opportunities. Educational attainment has been identified as a strong predictor of delayed marriage timing. Yet, the relationship between educational discontinuation and early union formation has not been comprehensively examined using recent nationally representative data. This study is the first to focus specifically on the Grade 9 lower secondary completion threshold using the 2021–22 CDHS, addressing an important evidence gap in the Southeast Asian literature.

Objective: To examine the association between educational discontinuation (completing fewer than 9 years of schooling) and early union formation (marriage or cohabitation before age 18) among young women in Cambodia, and to explore potential effect modification by residence and household wealth.

Methods: We analyzed data from 1,682 ever-married women aged 20–24 years from the 2021–22 Cambodia Demographic and Health Survey. Early union formation was defined as the first marriage or cohabitation before age 18. Educational discontinuation was operationalized as fewer than 9 years of schooling (i.e., not completing lower secondary education). Survey-weighted logistic regression was used to estimate odds ratios (ORs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs), adjusting for residence, wealth quintile, province, and sex of the household head. Given the outcome prevalence of approximately 31%, results are presented alongside predicted probabilities and absolute risk differences to complement odds ratio estimates. Stratified analyses examined associations by urban/rural residence and household poverty status.

Results: Early union formation prevalence was 30.9% (95% CI: 27.9–33.9). Two-thirds (65.8%) of young women had discontinued education before completing lower secondary school. In fully adjusted models, educational discontinuation was strongly associated with early union formation (aOR: 2.00, 95% CI: 1.41–2.83). The predicted probability of early union formation was 35.3% among those with <9 years of schooling compared with 22.0% among those with ≥9 years, representing a 13.3 percentage-point absolute difference. Associations were observed across urban/rural strata and wealth categories, with a larger point estimate among poor households (aOR: 3.13, 95% CI: 1.74–5.61), though the interaction did not reach statistical significance (p=0.10).

Conclusions: Educational discontinuation before completing lower secondary school is robustly associated with early union formation among young Cambodian women across diverse socioeconomic contexts. These findings support policies and programs aimed at keeping girls in school through at least lower secondary completion as one component of comprehensive strategies to address early marriage in Cambodia.

AI.tldr: 利用2021-22年柬埔寨人口健康调查数据，研究发现未完成九年级初中学业的年轻女性早婚或同居的概率（35.3%）显著高于完成者（22.0%），教育中断与早婚形成之间存在稳健的正向关联，该关联在城乡和不同财富水平群体中均存在，且贫困家庭中效应更大。
AI.research_question: 教育中断（未完成9年义务教育）与柬埔寨年轻女性早婚或同居（18岁前首次结婚/同居）之间的关联如何？该关联是否受到居住地（城乡）和家庭财富状况的调节？
AI.motivation: 早婚在柬埔寨仍是重要的公共卫生问题，对女性健康、教育及经济机会产生广泛影响。尽管教育程度被确定为推迟结婚时间的有力预测因素，但尚无研究利用近期全国代表性数据，专门聚焦于九年级初中毕业门槛这一关键教育中断节点，系统检验其与早婚形成的关系。该研究旨在填补东南亚文献中的重要证据空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育投资理论：教育作为人力资本投资，提高女性劳动市场回报和自主决策能力；社会规范理论：教育环境改变婚姻观念和家庭期望；贫困与资源约束理论：家庭经济压力可能迫使女性较早进入婚姻。
AI.method: 数据来源：2021-22年柬埔寨人口健康调查，纳入1,682名20-24岁曾婚女性。自变量：教育中断（<9年 schooling，即未完成初中），因变量：早婚形成（18岁前首次结婚或同居）。统计方法：调查加权逻辑回归估计OR和95%CI，调整居住地、财富五分组、省份和户主性别；因结局患病率约31%，补充报告预测概率和绝对风险差；按城乡及贫困状况进行分层分析。
AI.findings: 早婚形成患病率为30.9%；65.8%的年轻女性在完成初中前中断教育；完全调整模型中，教育中断与早婚形成强相关（aOR=2.00, 95%CI: 1.41-2.83）；<9年教育组预测概率为35.3%，≥9年组为22.0%，绝对差异13.3个百分点；该关联在城乡及不同财富水平中均存在，贫困家庭中点估计更大（aOR=3.13, 95%CI: 1.74-5.61），但交互作用未达统计显著（p=0.10）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用最新全国代表性数据，聚焦九年级初中毕业这一关键教育门槛，证实教育中断与早婚形成的独立稳健关联；发现该关联在不同社会经济群体中普遍存在，为教育投资理论和贫困约束理论提供了来自柬埔寨的新实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果为柬埔寨及相关东南亚国家的政策制定提供了重要参考：保障女童至少完成初中教育应作为预防早婚综合策略的核心组成部分；政策干预需特别关注贫困家庭的女性群体。

title: The Double Bind as Causal Mechanism in Kondratieff Long Waves: A Research Note

detail.title: The Double Bind as Causal Mechanism in Kondratieff Long Waves: A Research Note

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no financial or personal relationships with any organisations discussed in this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Long-wave scholarship has documented recurring forty-to-sixty-year economic cycles driven by infrastructure technologies but has not identified a structural mechanism that explains why every major infrastructure technology produces the same financial shape. This research note proposes that the mechanism is the simultaneous presence of industrial-scale costs that cannot be avoided and value dissolution that erodes the revenue base funding the buildout (proposed term: double bind). The note further proposes that the bind is the default trajectory of shared, privately financed infrastructure technology, and that the broad-based value creation associated with deployment phases is an engineered state requiring deliberate institutional intervention and continuous maintenance. The hypothesis draws on a sequence of seven consecutive markers identified through comparative analysis of railroads, electricity, telephony, and computing, published in the author's Silicon Industrialists series (Liberopoulou, 2026). This note states the hypothesis, identifies the published evidence base, and declares intent to develop the argument through a full literature review and working paper.

AI.tldr: 该研究笔记提出"双重束缚"（double bind）机制：基础设施技术同时面临不可规避的工业规模成本与侵蚀收入基础的价值消解，导致每项重大基础设施技术产生相同的金融周期形态（40-60年长波周期）。这一束缚是共享型私人融资基础设施技术的默认轨迹，而部署阶段广泛的价值创造是一种需要制度干预和持续维护的人为状态。
AI.research_question: 为什么每项重大基础设施技术（铁路、电力、电话、计算）都会产生相同的金融周期形态？其结构性机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 长波理论已记录40-60年经济周期由基础设施技术驱动，但未识别出解释"为何每项技术产生相同金融形态"的结构性机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 长波理论（Kondratiev周期）"; "双重束缚（double bind）概念——不可规避的工业规模成本与侵蚀收入基础的价值消解同时存在
AI.method: 基于作者已发表的"Silicon Industrialists"系列研究的比较历史分析，识别出铁路、电力、电话、计算四个案例中连续出现的七个标志性特征。
AI.findings: "双重束缚"是共享型私人融资基础设施技术的默认轨迹；部署阶段的广泛价值创造并非自然发生，而是需要制度干预和持续维护的人为工程状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 为长波理论提供了结构性微观机制解释（双重束缚），填补了"为何不同基础设施技术产生相同金融周期形态"的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者和投资者：基础设施技术的价值创造阶段是脆弱的、需要制度维护的工程状态，而非自动产生的自然过程，对当下AI等基础设施建设具有警示意义。

title: Khan | Neoliberalism and the Recurring Food Crisis: From Haiti and The Gambia to Pakistan's Wheat Reforms

detail.title: Khan | Neoliberalism and the Recurring Food Crisis: From Haiti and The Gambia to Pakistan's Wheat Reforms

declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, patients, or original interview data. It is based entirely on secondary sources — peer-reviewed academic literature, journalism, government and IMF policy documents, and international organisation reporting — supplemented by the author's general professional background in agricultural value chain and SME competitiveness work, as described in the paper. No ethics approval or participant consent was therefore required
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or funding from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted independently by the author as part of his ongoing professional and policy writing

detail.abstract: The 2007-08 food price crisis is usually told as a story about weather and speculation. Rice prices rose 31 percent in a single month; wheat rose 29 percent; riots followed in more than a dozen countries. I argue in this paper that the real story sits further back, in three decades of neoliberal agricultural restructuring that had already stripped developing countries of the capacity to absorb a shock like that one. Structural adjustment programmes, trade liberalisation, and the withdrawal of state support for domestic agriculture did not simply fail to prevent the crisis of 2007-08. They built the conditions for it. Drawing on Amartya Sen's entitlement approach-the insight that hunger is a failure of access and purchasing power, not food availability-I examine two cases from that earlier period, Haiti and The Gambia, where IMF-and World Bank-mandated liberalisation left domestic rice production unable to compete with subsidised imports, deepening dependency at precisely the moment global prices spiked. I then extend the analysis to a case still unfolding as I write: Pakistan's suspension of its decades-old wheat Minimum Support Price for the 2024-25 season, followed by a hybrid, private-sector-mediated arrangement from 2025-26, both under IMF Extended Fund Facility conditionality. The policy shift has already produced sharp production declines, farmer protests, and renewed import dependency in a country that had been substantially selfsufficient in wheat. I situate this within a second global food price shock, triggered by Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, and argue that the vulnerability exposed in 2007-08 was never resolved-only quietly obscured by a run of stable prices. The conclusion I drew in 2016 holds up better now than I expected it to: countries that kept domestic production capacity and negotiating leverage, India's expanding price support system chief among them, have weathered these shocks far better than countries that liberalised under outside pressure. Pakistan is the latest test of that pattern.

AI.tldr: 本文认为2007-08年粮食价格危机的真正根源并非天气或投机，而是过去三十年的新自由主义农业 restructuring，包括结构调整、贸易自由化和国家农业支持撤出。通过阿马蒂亚·森的"权利方法"理论，分析海地、冈比亚和巴基斯坦三个案例，论证自由化政策如何削弱发展中国家抵御粮食冲击的能力，并指出印度等保持国内生产能力和价格支持的国家表现更好。
AI.research_question: 2007-08年粮食价格危机的根本原因是什么？新自由主义农业 restructuring 如何影响发展中国家应对粮食冲击的能力？
AI.motivation: 挑战将粮食危机简单归因于天气和投机的流行叙事，揭示1970年代以来新自由主义农业政策改革（结构调整、贸易自由化、国家撤出）是如何系统地削弱了发展中国家应对粮食价格冲击的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阿马蒂亚·森的"权利方法"（Entitlement Approach）：饥饿的本质是获取和购买力的失败，而非粮食的绝对短缺。该框架将粮食不安全归因于人们获取粮食的经济和社会权利被剥夺。
AI.method: 比较案例研究：分析海地、冈比亚（2007-08危机前）和巴基斯坦（2024-2026年，当前正在发生）三个案例，通过历史追踪和过程分析展示国际货币基金组织和世界银行强制的自由化政策如何导致粮食依赖加深和脆弱性加剧。
AI.findings: 1) 新自由主义农业 restructuring 并未简单地未能预防危机，而是主动创造了危机条件；2) 海地和冈比亚在IMF/世行强制下的自由化使本国大米生产无法与补贴进口竞争，在全球价格飙升时加深了依赖；3) 巴基斯坦在IMF条件下暂停小麦最低支持价格已导致产量骤降、农民抗议和进口依赖重新抬头；4) 2007-08年暴露的脆弱性从未被解决，只是被一段平稳价格掩盖；5) 印度等保持国内生产能力和价格支持的国家应对冲击的能力远优于在外部压力下自由化的国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 将森的"权利方法"应用于农业政策变迁分析，将粮食危机的解释从短期外生冲击（天气、投机）转向长期制度性、政策性的脆弱性构建，强调了"权利失败"的结构性根源。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 批判性揭示国际金融机构（IMF、世行）贷款条件性对发展中国家粮食安全的系统性危害；2) 为巴基斯坦及其他面临IMF压力的发展中国家提供政策警示；3) 提供"保持国内生产能力和谈判筹码"作为更有效的粮食安全策略的比较证据。

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants and did not require ethics committee approval.

publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: With rising concerns about diet-related health issues and the declining quality of life due to obesity, many countries, such as the United States, have introduced taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) to decrease their consumption, improve public health, and fund health programs. A key question is whether these taxes are effective interventions, particularly for those most in need, such as individuals with hypertension, high cholesterol, type 2 diabetes, and other diet-related chronic diseases. Using the NielsenIQ Homescan Consumer Panel and Health Ailment Survey, I classify households into four health-risk subgroups via latent class analysis and apply an Augmented Synthetic Control Method across seven U.S. taxed cities, accounting for cross-border substitution. The highest-risk subgroup (High Multi-Morbidities, HMM) significantly reduces purchases, consistent with habit stock decumulation, while households with High Metabolic Dysfunction (HMD) increase purchases, reflecting continued habit stock accumulation. Low-risk households modestly reduce consumption and remain inelastic throughout. This heterogeneity in response calls for targeted interventions, such as differentiated tax rates, subsidies for healthier alternatives, and behavioral nudges to promote sustained behavioral change among vulnerable consumers.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国七座征税城市的数据，通过潜在类别分析和增强合成控制法，发现糖税对不同健康风险群体的购买行为存在显著异质性：高风险多重共病群体显著减少购买，高代谢功能障碍群体反而增加购买，低风险群体小幅减少且缺乏弹性。
AI.research_question: 糖税对不同健康风险亚群（尤其是患有高血压、高胆固醇、2型糖尿病等饮食相关慢性病的人群）的购买行为是否存在异质性影响？
AI.motivation: 全球多国已开征糖税以应对肥胖及相关健康问题，但该政策对最需要帮助的人群（如慢性病患者）是否有效尚不明确，现有研究缺乏对健康风险异质性的深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 习惯资本积累/折旧理论（habit stock accumulation/decumulation）：高风险多重共病群体减少购买符合习惯资本折旧，高代谢功能障碍群体增加购买符合习惯资本继续积累。
AI.method: 潜在类别分析（LCA）对健康风险分层；增强合成控制法（Augmented Synthetic Control Method）分析因果效应；考虑跨区替代购买行为。
AI.findings: （1）高风险多重共病（HMM）群体显著减少含糖饮料购买； （2）高代谢功能障碍（HMD）群体反而增加购买； （3）低风险群体小幅减少且需求缺乏弹性。不同健康风险群体的反应高度异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将习惯资本理论应用于糖税政策分析，揭示了不同健康风险群体在行为响应上的异质性模式，拓展了对糖税有效性边界的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供差异化干预建议：如差别税率、补贴健康替代品、行为助推等，以促进脆弱群体的可持续行为改变。

title: Macroeconomic Parameter Instability in Auto Loan Loss Models
